note: Step-by-step guide, written for this project in its own words. Facts checked against the IGN walkthrough of the remake (each chapter names its page); no text or images from it. English here; walkthrough-strings.json holds pt-BR and es-ES.

chapters.title: Link wakes up
chapters.summary: Get a shield and a sword in Kokiri Forest so Mido lets you see the Great Deku Tree.

steps.text: Leave Link's treehouse and climb down the ladder. Saria is waiting at the bottom and sends you to the Great Deku Tree.
Follow the path past the cave by the water to the Great Deku Tree's grove. Use the new jump button to cross the stepping stones.
Mido blocks the way. He wants to see a sword and a shield first.
The Kokiri Shop sells the Deku Shield for 40 Rupees. Collect the Rupees around the village first.
Easy Rupees: a Blue Rupee in a corner of the shop, one under the small waterfall, pots outside the House of the Twins, rocks across the stream west of the shop, and the chests inside Mido's House.
steps.tip: Rupees in chests or out in the open appear once. Grass, rocks and pots refill when you come back.

steps.text: Go back to the shop and buy the Deku Shield.
Climb the hill to the Training Grounds, south across from Mido's House. Finish the boy's targeting lesson on the scarecrow dummies.
Crawl through the small tunnel by the wall. A boulder rolls around a central platform; run behind it and duck into the alcoves when it comes back.
Climb the ladder on the south side, then jump across to the central platform and open the chest.
Crawl back out. The boy teaches the jump attack: target an enemy, jump, then attack in the air for double damage.
Show Mido your gear and he steps aside.
Defeat the three Deku Babas in the passage. Cutting their stems drops Deku Sticks.
Talk to the Great Deku Tree. He asks you to break the curse inside him.

chapters.title: Inside the Great Deku Tree
chapters.summary: Climb, then drop through the Great Deku Tree, defeat Gohma and get Kokiri's Emerald.

steps.text: Walk in through the Great Deku Tree's mouth. A thick web covers the pit in the middle; you need to get high enough to break it.
The Deku Babas here lunge at you. Step back out of reach, then strike. Their heads drop Deku Nuts and their stems drop Deku Sticks.
Climb the green vines to the second floor. Follow the ledge to the big chest at the foot of the next vine wall for the Dungeon Map.
Take the door at the far end of the second floor. It locks behind you. Hold up your shield so the Deku Scrub's nut bounces back at it.
Chase the stunned Scrub and hit it when it runs out of breath. The door opens.
Run across the wooden bridge before it collapses. Open the chest on the far platform for the Fairy Slingshot.
Shoot the Skullwalltula on the small vine wall by the chest, then climb up to a hidden chest with Deku Nuts.
Shoot the eye above the door. A ladder drops down; climb it to get back to the main room.
Shoot the three Skullwalltulas off the big vine wall, then climb it to the third floor.
Move sideways along the vines and drop onto the ring-shaped walkway above the web.
A Skulltula guards the first door on the left. Back off when it spins, then hit its belly. Two hits or one jump attack finish it.
Inside, step on the stone button on the right to raise three platforms. Cross before they sink; a Deku Baba waits on the far side.
Open the chest for the Compass.
Cut the grass behind the chest, crawl through the tunnel and climb the vines to a chest with Deku Nuts.
From the sunken middle, defeat the Skulltula below the high ledge with something gold on it. Press the button again and hop left to the ledge for a Gold Skulltula.
Go back to the main room and keep climbing. Defeat the Skulltulas on the way to the top walkway.
Jump off the top into the middle of the room. You crash through the web and land in a pool in the basement.
Turn around as you swim out. Shoot the Gold Skulltula on the vine wall, then climb up for its token.
Drop down by the water that splits the room. Shoot the Gold Skulltula on the grate to the north and jump over for the token.
Step on the stone switch near the grate to light the torch. The flame burns the web over a small chest with Deku Sticks.
Light a Deku Stick on the torch, run along the platforms to the south and burn the web over the door. Put the stick away afterwards.
Reflect a nut back at the Deku Scrub in the next room. Then shoot the eye above the far door to open it.
A floating platform here can't fit under the spiked log. Dive in on the left, below a grate, and press the switch on the floor to lower the water.
Ride the platform under the spikes to the other side.
Defeat the Skulltula by the high ledge. Push the stone block on the left over to the ledge and climb across.
Light a Deku Stick on the burning torch and light all three braziers before it burns out. The door unlocks.
steps.tip: The Deku Babas in this room drop more sticks if you run low.

steps.text: In the next room a Skulltula drops from above, then three eggs hatch into Gohma Larvae. Block or sidestep their lunge, then strike back.
Burn the web in the north-west corner with a lit stick. Defeat the Deku Baba and the Skulltula, then shoot the Gold Skulltula on the back vines and climb up for it.
Back in the larva room, burn the web on the east side and crawl through the passage. It leads to the first basement room.
Push the big stone block off the ledge so it lands below, near the torch in the corner.
Light a Deku Stick, cross the water again, climb onto the block with the stick still lit and roll into the web on the floor. Drop through to the lower basement.
Three Deku Scrubs guard this room. Number them 1, 2, 3 from left to right and bounce nuts back in the order 2, 3, 1. Dodge the other shots.
Catch the last Scrub when it flees; it gives you a hint about the boss. Cut the bushes for seeds and nuts, then take the door.
Look up when you walk in: Gohma is on the ceiling. Her only weak spot is her eye.
When she raises her claws, backflip away. Her claws stick in the ground; slash the eye as soon as it turns green.
When she climbs the walls, wait for the eye to turn green and shoot it with the Slingshot. Shoot any eggs she drops before they hatch.
A hit to the eye knocks her down. Run in and slash or jump attack while she's dizzy.
steps.tip: Recovery Hearts lie around the edge of the arena.

steps.text: Repeat about three times to defeat her.
Take the Heart Container she leaves behind.
Step into the blue light to warp out. The Great Deku Tree tells you about the Triforce and gives you Kokiri's Emerald.
Go back to the village and tell Mido. Saria is upset you're leaving. Stock up at the shop or rest in Link's house if you need to.
Head for the western exit. The Kokiri guarding it lets you pass now.
Saria stops you on the bridge and gives you the Fairy Ocarina. Next stop: Hyrule Castle, across Hyrule Field.

chapters.title: The Princess of Hyrule
chapters.summary: Cross Hyrule Field, sneak into Hyrule Castle and meet Princess Zelda.

steps.text: Kaepora Gaebora lands as you leave the woods. He points you down the road north-west to Hyrule Castle and tells you about the Threads of Time, your quest log.
Look west for a tall, thin tree on a hill above the ranch. Cross the stream and roll into it for a Gold Skulltula.
steps.tip: Time doesn't pass on this first trip and the drawbridge stays down, so you can explore until you meet Zelda.

steps.text: Follow the dirt road north. Block the Peahats with your shield, then hit them while they're stunned.
Cross the drawbridge over the moat into town.
Turn right into the guard house by the gate. Break the pots for about 20 Rupees.
Roll into the crates at the back of the room. One hides a Gold Skulltula.
In the plaza, listen to the two men by the fountain. One got stuck in a drainpipe trying to see the Princess.
Go into the Potion Shop and catch the golden bug that got loose. The owner gives you an Empty Bottle and fills it with Red Potion.
Take the road up the hill to the castle.
Kaepora Gaebora warns you about the guards, and the one at the gate sends you away.
Talk to Malon by the milk cart on the right. She gives you the Weird Egg to wake up her father, Talon.
Past the drain, climb the green vines to a high ledge, then the next vines to the top of the gatehouse.
Garden guards throw you out if they see you. Jump the iron fence behind the bushes, or walk up the road and slip left through the purple flowers before the bend.
Weave through the middle of the hedges and head for the west wall.
Before climbing, roll into the tall thin tree in the small area on the right with barrels and sacks for a Gold Skulltula.
Climb the vines past a Sheikah Stone. Skip the moat guards by swimming across to the tree on the far side.
Talon is asleep up the path. The egg has hatched by now; use the Wake-up Cucco on him.
Talon runs home and leaves his milk crates. Push both into the dip below the drainpipe, one on top of the other, then jump up and crawl in.
Climb the ladder to look over the first area.
steps.tip: If a guard spots you in here, you only go back to the drain.

steps.text: Climb the crates beside the gazebo and cross the beam above the guard.
Two guards walk between two hedges. When the near one turns away, run to the right side of the first hedge and hide.
Wait for the second guard to head left, then run to the second hedge and on to the next area.
In the cellar, one guard walks a square around the shelves and another stands between them looking both ways. Go down once the walker has passed and turned away.
Go up the left side when the middle guard looks right, or trail the walking guard at a distance. Leave by the far door and turn left.
Talk to the girl at the window across the garden. Zelda tells you about her dream, the three Spiritual Stones and Ganondorf.
She gives you Zelda's Letter.
Talk to Impa when you're ready to go. Play along with her to learn Zelda's Lullaby.
Impa sends you to Kakariko Village, at the foot of Death Mountain. Lon Lon Ranch is worth a visit on the way.
Play the shooting gallery in the plaza for 10 Rupees: hit all 10 targets with 15 seeds to win the Bigger Deku Seed Bag.
steps.tip: Hitting 8 or 9 targets gets you a free retry.

steps.text: Then try the Expert Course. Each perfect score pays 30 Rupees.
The Bazaar sells the Hylian Shield, but you can get one for free later. Save your Rupees.

chapters.title: Lon Lon Ranch and Kakariko Village
chapters.summary: Learn Epona's Song at the ranch, open the gate to Death Mountain and find the Sun's Song and a free Hylian Shield in the graveyard.

steps.text: Head for Lon Lon Ranch, straight across the field from town.
steps.tip: From now on day turns to night. Keep holding the roll after a roll to run faster; it doesn't use stamina.

steps.text: During the day, find Malon singing to a foal in the horse field. Play along on the Fairy Ocarina to learn Epona's Song.
Enter the ruined stone tower in the south-west corner. Pull out the near crates to clear two spaces in the middle row, then pull the middle crate off the wall and crawl through for a Heart Piece.
Wake Talon in the main house and play his game: find his three Super Cuccos in the crowd before time runs out. You win a bottle of Lon Lon Milk.
steps.tip: Super Cuccos stand stiff and upright with their wings down and head high, and flap wildly now and then.

steps.text: Behind the main house, in the yard with a wooden tower, roll into the tall thin tree for a Gold Skulltula.
Leave the ranch and take the stone stairs to the north-east up to Kakariko Village.
The stairs on the left lead to the gate to Death Mountain. Look around the village first.
Roll into the narrow tree by the big tree in the middle of the village, where the carpenter boss yells at his workers, for a Gold Skulltula.
The Cucco Lady below Impa's old house has lost all seven of her Cuccos. Bring each one back to her pen.
Cucco 1 walks around the scaffolding of the house being built nearby. Cucco 2 is by the village gate. Cucco 3 is in a crate beside the house of the woman cooking for the village.
Carry a Cucco up to Impa's house and glide down to Cucco 4 on the pile of bricks. Cucco 5 is on the stairs north toward Death Mountain, past the wooden tower.
Carry a Cucco to the windmill on the west side and glide over the gap in the fence. Throw it back over. Cucco 6 is below the closed Potion Shop.
steps.tip: A hole in the ground over here leads to a grotto with a chest.

steps.text: Cucco 7 is up the ladder on the hill behind the windmill. Throw each one over the fence on the well side, then carry them to the pen.
Holding Cucco 7, glide onto the blue roof of the Potion Shop. The man lying on the lower roof near the tower gives you a Heart Piece.
Return all seven Cuccos for an Empty Bottle.
The web-covered house below the windmill is the House of Skulltula. Every 10 tokens you bring earns a reward from the cursed family.
steps.tip: Keep a bug in a bottle. Drop it on soft soil and a Gold Skulltula comes out.

steps.text: Wait outside for night. A Gold Skulltula shows up on the small web left of the door.
Go inside with 10 tokens to get the Adult's Wallet. It holds 500 Rupees.
At night, climb the scaffolding of the house being built near the Cucco Lady. A Gold Skulltula sits high on the red brick wall.
At night, shoot the Gold Skulltula on the ladder of the wooden tower, then climb up for its token.
At night, walk around the back of the boy's house south of the tower and the Potion Shop. A Gold Skulltula is on the wall.
Climb the steps to the gate to Death Mountain. Show the guard Zelda's Letter and he opens it.
He asks you to bring him a mask from the new Happy Mask Shop in town and offers a discount on the Hylian Shield. Skip the shield; there's a free one in the graveyard.
Go past the windmill to the graveyard. By day a boy stops you from touching the graves.
Take the steps on the left and drop a bug on the soft soil past the small tree for a Gold Skulltula.
steps.tip: No bug? Lift the rocks at the graveyard entrance.

steps.text: At night, Dampé offers his gravedigging tour. Pay 10 Rupees per dig. When he finds something heavy, pay 5 more for a Heart Piece.
At the back, the two harp-shaped graves beside the royal crest hold the Composer Brothers, Sharp and Flat. Pull them to start the fight.
steps.tip: Like other Poes, they vanish if you target them. Back off until they appear, then rush in and strike.

steps.text: Stand on the royal crest and play Zelda's Lullaby to open the tomb.
The first room locks you in with Keese. Shoot them early, or block and slash when they turn away.
In the next room, three ReDeads stand around bubbling goo. Walk slowly along the left of the first pit, then dash through the middle to the far door.
Learn the Sun's Song from the plaque at the end. It switches between day and night.
Have Navi read the twinkling blue mark on a pillar and play the Sun's Song there. A fairy pops out and heals you.
Back in the ReDead room, play the Sun's Song to freeze them, then defeat them all.
Pull graves from behind at night, when Dampé is out. Some hide Rupees, some a Poe.
In the first row, the grave with flowers opens onto a sealed tomb. You can't blast it open yet.
In the row below the royal tomb steps, pull back the second grave on the right. Freeze the ReDead with the Sun's Song, defeat it and open the chest for the Hylian Shield.
Pull back the grave at the south end of the same row and drop in. The chest holds a Heart Piece.
The Happy Mask Shop in town is open. Borrow the Keaton Mask, sell it to the Kakariko gate guard for 15 Rupees and pay the shop back 10.
Then borrow the Skull Mask. You'll meet a buyer soon.
At night, the lady in town has lost her white dog, Richard. He's at the back corner of the alley past the Bombchu Shop, near the Treasure Chest Shop. Lead him home for a Heart Piece.
steps.tip: Other white dogs roam the alley. If she says it's the wrong one, try again.

chapters.title: Goron City and the Lost Woods
chapters.summary: Climb to Goron City, find Saria in the Sacred Forest Meadow and cheer Darunia up for the Goron's Bracelet.

steps.text: Equip the Hylian Shield before you start up the trail. It blocks fire too.
Red Tektites jump at you. Let them bounce off your shield, then strike back.
Climb the mesh wall to the ledge with the blocked cave. The hungry Goron there says Dodongo's Cavern has been sealed.
Keep climbing past the rolling Goron. Rocks block the way to the summit, so turn sharp left into the tunnel to Goron City.
A Goron by the entrance watches a Bomb Flower. You're not strong enough to pick it up yet.
Go right and cross the rope bridges to the altar. The Goron there says Darunia took their tasty red stone and shut himself in his room.
Head down past the rolling Goron. On the next level, a Goron listens to music coming through a cracked wall.
Keep going down. Grab a Deku Stick from the pots by the Goron at the resting spot if you're low.
On the bottom floor, play Zelda's Lullaby at the door with the Triforce mat to meet Darunia.
Darunia is in a foul mood. Outside, a Goron tells you his big brother has a favorite song.
Light a Deku Stick on a torch in Darunia's room. Run next door and light the Bomb Flower by the sealed door to open the Goron Shop.
steps.tip: Most of what it sells is no use to you yet.

steps.text: Light another stick and run around the big Goron-shaped pot, lighting all four torches. The pot starts to spin. Put the stick away.
Light a stick on those torches, go up a level and light the Bomb Flowers at the cracked wall where the music comes from. It opens a shortcut to the Lost Woods.
Kaepora Gaebora meets you inside. Follow the music: if it fades at a tunnel, that's the wrong way and you end up back at the start.
From the Goron City shortcut, go left, then left again at the pool of water.
Go straight through the four-way crossing to an area with one boulder and turn left. At the next single boulder, turn right.
A Wolfos guards the gate. Backflip away from its double swipe; after the second swipe it shows its back. Jump attack the scar there.
Follow the zigzag maze. Block the Mad Scrubs' three nuts; the third one bounces back and sends the Scrub running.
Go around the square area with water in the corners to the last narrow path. Shoot the Scrubs there from a distance.
Climb the stairs to Saria. Play along with her to learn Saria's Song.
steps.tip: Play it anywhere to talk to Saria for advice.

steps.text: On the way back, drop into the hole by the opening at the foot of the stairs. The Fairy Fountain inside heals you, and you can bottle a fairy.
Take the shortcut back to Goron City and play Saria's Song for Darunia. He dances, then asks you to clear out Dodongo's Cavern.
He gives you the Goron's Bracelet, so you can pick up Bomb Flowers.
On the top ring, east of the entrance, throw Bomb Flowers at the cracked walls to reach Medigoron. His project isn't ready yet.
Go back out to the trail. Pick up the Bomb Flower the Goron is watching and throw it down onto the cracked boulder below. Dodongo's Cavern opens.
Drop a bug on the soft soil just inside the tunnel for a Gold Skulltula.
Take a wrong turn in the Lost Woods to reach Kokiri Forest. Drop a bug on the soft soil behind the Kokiri Shop for a Gold Skulltula.
At night, look on the treehouse wall behind the House of the Know-It-All Brothers for a Gold Skulltula. The Sun's Song makes it night.
From the Lost Woods entrance, go left. Stand on the small stump by the Skull Kid and play Saria's Song with him for a Heart Piece.
Take the tunnel south from the Skull Kid to a ledge above the bridge. Drop a bug on the soft soil for a Gold Skulltula.
Drop into the ravine below the bridge and cross it. Beat the Business Scrub, then buy the Bigger Deku Stick Bag for 40 Rupees.
From the entrance, go right. Stand on the stump and hit the center of the tree ring target three times for the Biggest Deku Seed Bag.
Drop down to the two Skull Kids and play their copy game. Win three rounds in a row of longer tunes for a Heart Piece.
steps.tip: The first two rounds pay a Blue Rupee and a Red Rupee.

steps.text: From the Goron City shortcut, go right to the pool, then left going north, then left again. Drop a bug on the soft soil by the big tree among the Business Scrubs.
Drop into the hole in the bushes there to reach the Forest Stage. Wear the Skull Mask on the stage for the Biggest Deku Stick Bag.
Then wear the Skull Mask for the Skull Kid by the stump. He buys it for only 10 Rupees, so you pay the rest of its price to the shop.

chapters.title: Dodongo's Cavern
chapters.summary: Clear the cavern on Death Mountain, beat King Dodongo and earn Goron's Ruby from Darunia.

steps.text: Grab the Bomb Flower next to the cracked wall at the back of the cave and throw it at the wall to open the real entrance.
Read the plaque in front of the giant skull. It hints at a hidden path you will open later.

sections.title: Dungeon Map and the east door

steps.text: Ride the small rising platform over the lava up to the big central platform. The lava is shallow but keeps burning you.
Stay out of the Beamos' line of sight and hop over to the west side. Throw the Bomb Flower next to that Beamos, then step back from its falling head.
Bomb the south alcove for a Blue Rupee, then the north alcove for the Dungeon Map.
Carry a Bomb Flower back across, blow up the central Beamos and continue to the east side. Destroy the Beamos there too.
Bomb the north alcove on the east side (only a Sheikah Stone), then the south alcove to open a doorway.
Baby Dodongos explode a moment after you cut them, so hit and back away.
Near the end of the hall, kill a Baby Dodongo next to the big cracked wall on the right. The blast opens it and shows a Gold Skulltula.
Climb the ledge and pull one of the statues onto the pressure plate so the door stays open.
Fight the two Lizalfos. Keep your shield up, even when one jumps over you, and strike back when it staggers.
steps.tip: Pots near the back of the arena hold Recovery Hearts.

steps.text: Take the northwest door and blow open the cracked doorway with the Bomb Flower. Deflect the Business Scrub's nut and buy Deku Sticks.
In the long room, bait each Dodongo into breathing fire, then run behind it and hit its tail. Back off before it spins.
Light a Deku Stick on the lit torch and touch the three unlit braziers before they go out. A door back to the main hall opens.
Step on the switch in the main hall to open the door on the west side.
In the new room, bomb the south cracked wall. Lure the Armos into a Bomb Flower, then climb the far ladder for the Compass.
Go north to the raised staircase ringed by Bomb Flowers. Put a loose Bomb Flower in the gap to set off the chain and sink the stairs.
Climb the stairs. Before the south exit, shoot the Gold Skulltula and the Skullwalltulas on the mesh wall, then climb up for the token.
Equip the Hylian Shield from here on so the Fire Keese can't burn your Deku Shield.
Drop to the central platform. Bomb the Armos statues or avoid them, pull out the south statue, climb its ladder and press the switch to open the east door.
Cross the upper level above the giant skull, jumping the gap in the bridge, to reach the room with moving spike traps.
Slip past the spikes to the east ladder and pull down the square stone below it. Climb onto the platforms and throw the Bomb Flower up at the cracked wall.
Shoot the eye switch at the far end of the hall to put out the burning platform.
Beat the next pair of Lizalfos. Then follow the narrow path north to a chest with a Business Scrub Seed.
On the way back, shoot the first eye switch, jump, then turn left and shoot the second eye through a small window. Cross before the flames return.
Open the big chest in the spike room for the Bomb Bag.
Bomb the cracked wall behind the chest. The switch beyond turns one of the lava platforms into a lift to the second floor.
Bomb the cracked wall in the northeast corner by the skull. A Gold Skulltula hides behind the rock in the middle; a Dodongo's blast can kill it too.
On the bridge over the skull, drop a bomb through each small gap into the eye sockets. The jaw lowers and opens the way to the boss.
Bomb the wall at the far end of the bridge for a Blue Rupee.
Back in the west room with the sunken stairs, climb the ladder at the top and bomb the cracked wall for another Business Scrub Seed.
Walk through the skull's mouth and head north. Watch for Fire Keese overhead.
In the room of narrow paths, pull the low block under the raised one, climb up and push the raised block down.
Push that block to the far wall, set a bomb on top to break the cracked wall and climb in. Bomb the Armos at the back to get the Gold Skulltula.
Push the block under the one by the south exit and climb over both.
Push the last block down into the hole in the floor to open the boss door.
Bomb the cracked floor in the next room and drop down.
When King Dodongo opens his mouth to breathe fire, throw a bomb in. Bomb Flowers also grow along each side of the arena.
While he is stunned, slash his tongue or use a jump attack.
When he rolls, back away to the extra space at a corner and let him hit the wall. Kill the Baby Dodongos before you ready the next bomb.
Repeat three times and he rolls into the lava.
Take the Heart Container and step into the blue light.
Darunia names you his Sworn Brother and gives you Goron's Ruby.
On the trail down to Kakariko, bomb the cracked wall near the Red Tektites. A Gold Skulltula waits inside, even by day.
In Goron City, bomb the boulders on the upper left of the entrance floor. Blast right, left, then straight ahead and break the crate for a Gold Skulltula.
One floor down, stand at the tunnel sign and plant a bomb as the rolling Goron enters the far side. Stop him for the Bigger Bomb Bag.
From the plank above the spinning pot, throw a bomb in. If it stops on the happy face, you get a Piece of Heart.
On the trail's west side, bomb the cracked wall for a Business Scrub Seed. Higher up, bomb the noisy boulder for a grotto with a cow.
Play Epona's Song for the cow to fill an empty bottle with Lon Lon Milk.
Near the summit, rocks rain down. Sprint to the far wall, shield up if a rock is coming, and shoot the Skullwalltulas before you climb.
Bomb the wall left of Kaepora Gaebora. Play Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce mark and offer 25 Rupees for the magic meter and Din's Fire.
Move fast. The heat starts hurting you after about 4 seconds, and any healing resets that timer.
steps.tip: Recovery Hearts from pots and rocks, or Lon Lon Milk, buy you more time.

steps.text: Run ahead and roll into the farther of the two crates by a pot on the left for a Gold Skulltula.
Go right between two big rocks and climb down the mesh. A Piece of Heart sits in the alcove below.
Climb back up and head northwest to a low platform by a broken bridge. The Business Scrub there sells a Piece of Heart for 100 Rupees.
Back at the summit, let Kaepora Gaebora fly you down. From Impa's House roof, drop onto the cow pen roof for a Piece of Heart.
With 20 tokens, visit the House of Skulltula for the Echo Gem. It flashes when a Gold Skulltula is close.
Bombs open the grottos under cracked rocks all over Hyrule. Burn beehives inside with Din's Fire for Rupees.
Bomb the grotto in the woods south of Lon Lon Ranch, by a big Peahat. Its Gold Skulltula needs the Boomerang, so come back later.
Bomb the cracked boulder in the Lost Woods by the Sacred Forest Meadow entrance. A Business Scrub inside sells a bigger Deku Nut bag for 40 Rupees.
The Bombchu Shop and Bombchu Bowling Alley are open now. A game costs 10 Rupees: hit 3 targets with 10 Bombchus.
Win the advanced course for the Biggest Bomb Bag.
Win the expert course for a Piece of Heart.
If you sold the Skull Mask, rent the Spooky Mask for 30 Rupees. The Graveyard kid in Kakariko buys it by day for 50.
Pay back the Happy Mask Shop and rent the Bunny Hood. Its buyer comes later.
At Hyrule Castle, bomb the cracked wall east of the path past the gatehouse. Play Zelda's Lullaby and offer 50 Rupees for the stronger Spin Attack.
As you leave, Impa says the last Spiritual Stone is with the Zoras. Head for Zora's River.

chapters.title: Princess Ruto is missing
chapters.summary: Follow Zora's River to the Zoras, find Ruto's letter in Lake Hylia and get swallowed by Lord Jabu-Jabu.

steps.text: Follow the stream in Hyrule Field to the tunnel southeast of Kakariko's entrance. Kaepora Gaebora waits at the river.
Bomb the cracked boulders blocking the path.
The Bean Seller by the closed gate sells Magic Beans. Each one costs 10 Rupees more than the last; buy at least two.
Drop a bug on the soft soil next to him for a Gold Skulltula, then plant a Magic Bean there.
Jump across the river ledges to get around the gate. Hold up your shield when an Octorok spits a rock so it bounces back.
Keep to the left bank upriver. Lure the Blue Tektites onto dry ground before you fight them.
At the falls, climb the arching platforms to the plaque and play Zelda's Lullaby. The waterfall parts.
Climb the big staircase to King Zora. Princess Ruto has gone missing with the Spiritual Stone of Water, and he can't send you since you can't swim deep.
Follow the waterway out of the throne room to the Diving Instructor at the top of the waterfall. Dive for all five scales within 40 seconds.
He gives you the Silver Scale, so you can dive much deeper.
Dive into the small hole in the wall of the main pool. The current takes you out to Lake Hylia.
Swim toward the trail of bubbles ahead and dive to the bottom to pick up a bottle.
Read it on shore. It is Ruto's letter: she is trapped inside Lord Jabu-Jabu.
Go back to King Zora and open the bottle in front of him. He reads the letter and moves aside, opening the way behind him.
At the bottom of the domain, in the shallows by the path up to the shop, catch a fish in your now empty bottle.
Walk out to Zora's Fountain. Take out the fish at Lord Jabu-Jabu's offering spot and he swallows you whole.
In an alcove on the north cliff of the river, play songs for the frogs. Each new song earns Rupees; come back as you learn more.
Carry the lone Cucco from beside the Bean Seller's gate upriver, throw it up the last ledge and glide to the high island platform. Climb the vines.
On the island, bomb the cracked boulder for a Fairy Fountain grotto. A second grotto on the south side holds a Business Scrub Seed and another Cucco.
Take that Cucco to the narrow ledge by the Sheikah Stone and glide to the Piece of Heart above the frogs.
Carry the same Cucco to the falls. From the high ledge past the deep pool, glide to the Piece of Heart on the tiny northwest platform.
At night, drop to the shallow water below the falls. A Gold Skulltula appears behind the vines by the central platform.
In Zora's Domain, light a Deku Stick at the throne room torches and run it to every torch down to the bottom and behind the waterfall. A chest with a Piece of Heart appears.
With the Silver Scale, the deep pool outside the domain's entrance is a shortcut to the Lost Woods.
By the laboratory, drop a bug on the soft soil for a Gold Skulltula, then plant a Magic Bean.
On the east shore, play any tune for Pierre, then play an eight note song of your own for Bonooru. Write it down; you will need it as an adult.
steps.tip: As an adult, play the same song for Bonooru to learn the Scarecrow's Song.

steps.text: Past the rope bridge, pull back the gravestone by Kaepora Gaebora. Light three of the four torches with Din's Fire for a Red Rupee.
On the southern tip of the southwest shore, climb a tiny ledge and crawl through the tunnel for a Gold Skulltula.
Rent a rod at the Fishing Pond. Land a fish over 40 cm for a Piece of Heart.
Before feeding Jabu-Jabu, take the shallow path south. Roll into the tall narrow trees to knock down a Gold Skulltula.
Bomb the big cracked wall there. At the Great Fairy Fountain, offer 100 Rupees for Farore's Wind, a warp point you can set inside a dungeon.

chapters.title: Inside Lord Jabu-Jabu
chapters.summary: Carry Ruto through Jabu-Jabu, defeat Barinade for Zora's Sapphire, then open the Door of Time.

steps.text: Bounce the two Octoroks' rocks back with your shield. Then shoot the glowing growth hanging from the ceiling with the Slingshot to open the far door.
steps.tip: Walk back into the jaws to leave at any time. The mouth stays open, so you can come straight back in.

steps.text: The Biri here shock you even through your sword, and seeds bounce off. Stun one with a Deku Nut and slash it, or hit it with a Deku Stick.
In the next room, Ruto refuses help sent by her father and drops through a hole in the floor. Follow her down to B1.
steps.tip: Set a Farore's Wind point at the top of this room in case you fall later.

steps.text: Talk to her again. She lets you carry her while she looks for her lost stone. Pick her up and hold her over your head.
Carry Ruto east. Throw her at the Shabom bubbles to pop them safely; your seeds won't hurt them.
In the room with the sunken pit, set Ruto down and walk closer. Shoot the Stingers that rise out of the water, or block their dives with your shield.
Step on the glowing switch in the pit to raise the water, then swim to the chest on the east side for the Dungeon Map.
Climb the vines on the west side to a high ledge with pots and a Gold Skulltula.
To bring Ruto over, lower the water with the other switch, carry her into the pit and throw her across from a raised platform. Raise the water again and swim after her.
A big Bari ambushes you on the way out. Stun it with a Deku Nut; it splits into three Biri, so finish them with a bomb or Din's Fire.
steps.tip: In the remake, Ruto stays exactly where you set her down, even if you leave the dungeon.

steps.text: In the narrow room ahead, shoot the ceiling growth past the Octorok. A blue lift appears that goes back up to 1F.
Before riding it, dive through the underwater passage on the far side. Reflect the Business Scrub's shot and he sells Deku Nuts, Deku Sticks and Business Scrub Seeds.
Ride the lift up with Ruto and go back to the room where she fell. A green barrier now covers one hole, with a vein running out the north door.
Slip past the Bari and Biri into the north hallway. It splits into five passages leading to round rooms.
Take the first left. Set Ruto on the raised switch to hold the door open.
Draw the Stingers out of the floor one at a time and shoot them, or bunch them up for Din's Fire. The big chest that appears holds the Boomerang.
Pick Ruto back up. In the main corridor, target a Tailpasaran's tail and throw the Boomerang so it curves around and hits from behind.
Follow the red vein right and use Ruto on the switch. Strafe around the red tentacle and Boomerang its frayed middle until it dies and the vein vanishes.
Follow the blue vein left. The blue tentacle lunges straight at you, so keep moving; Boomerang it and the Biri around it.
Check the right room with no vein first. Spam the Boomerang at the swarm of Shabom to make a chest appear with the Compass.
In the north room, the green tentacle swings and slams the floor until it stuns itself. Jump attack it then, or keep using the Boomerang. Its death clears the green barrier.
Carry Ruto back to the room with the holes and drop through the one the barrier covered.
steps.tip: This ledge is a good place for a Farore's Wind point.

steps.text: From the ledge, look at the north wall past the Biri. Boomerang the Gold Skulltula; it brings the token back too.
Down on the lower floor, the southwest door has a swaying platform. Boomerang it to freeze it, jump over and open the chest for a Red Rupee.
Back on the high ledge, take the hall northwest. Boomerang the Gold Skulltula on its ceiling.
In the next room, Ruto spots her stone on the high platform. Throw her up there; she grabs it and the platform rises away.
Big Octo charges around the ring. Stun it with the Boomerang, run behind it and jump attack the green growth on its back.
When it burrows, pop the nearby Shabom and find where it comes back up. Repeat three times to defeat it.
Ride the lowered platform up to 2F and take the corridor south.
Two swaying platforms block the water. Boomerang both to freeze them and cross.
The next door needs a weight on its switch. Follow the small platforms down to a stone block, throw it up to the main platform, climb the vines and set it on the switch.
In the watery room, check the vines on the back of the tall pillar. Shoot the Gold Skulltula there.
Climb to the top of the pillar. Target the shielded growth in the ceiling and throw the Boomerang so it curves around the barrier. The door below opens.
Keep circling to dodge the lightning. Boomerang the frayed top of each of the three cords holding Barinade to the ceiling.
Its jellyfish now spin around it as an electric shield you can't hurt. Keep away until its core glows bright and shorts out.
While the shield is down, run in and slash as many jellyfish as you can. You may need two rounds to clear them.
steps.tip: Pots along the outer wall refill your hearts.

steps.text: Next its body rises and charges at you, glowing purple. Run sideways, then Boomerang the body when the jellyfish slow down, and cut the jellyfish it leaves exposed.
Last, it flies around shooting lightning everywhere. Get close, Boomerang it to the ground, then use jump and spin attacks. Two or three rounds finish it.
Take the Heart Container.
Step into the blue light. Outside, Ruto calms down and gives you Zora's Sapphire, a gift meant for her future husband.
With all three Spiritual Stones, head back toward Hyrule Castle Town. Dark clouds hang over it and the drawbridge is up.
As you walk up, Zelda and Impa ride out and Zelda throws something into the moat. Ganondorf knocks you aside and rides after them.
Look for the blue glow in the moat and pick up the Ocarina of Time.
Zelda appears in a vision and teaches you the Song of Time, the melody that opens the door in the Temple of Time.
steps.tip: Once you pull the sword, you can't come back as a child for a long while. Do the side content below first.

steps.text: In the Temple of Time, stand at the altar inscription and play the Song of Time. The stones settle into the altar and the Door of Time opens.
Walk into the chamber behind it and pull the Master Sword from its pedestal. Someone has been waiting for exactly this.
At Zora's Fountain, play the Sun's Song for night. Climb the archway in the water and Boomerang the Gold Skulltula on the far wall.
On the way down Zora's River, buy at least seven Magic Beans from the Bean Seller for the soft soil spots below.
In Hyrule Field, catch the running man, or find him sitting by a boulder at night. Wear the Bunny Hood and he buys it for 200 Rupees.
Pay the Happy Mask Shop its 50 Rupees. You can now borrow every mask, including the Mask of Truth, which reads people's thoughts and works on Sheikah Stones.
At Lon Lon Ranch at night, Boomerang the Gold Skulltula on the window of the house by the track entrance.
Also at night, enter the ranch's southwest stone tower and Boomerang the Gold Skulltula crawling high above the vines.
With 30 tokens, the House of Skulltula gives you the Giant's Wallet. It holds 1,000 Rupees.
In the graveyard at night, Boomerang the Gold Skulltula high on the wall behind Dampé's hut.
With 40 tokens, go back to the House of Skulltula for 20 Bombchus.
Plant a Magic Bean in the soft soil by the lone tree on the graveyard's north side.
Hike up Death Mountain Trail and plant another in the soil outside Dodongo's Cavern.
Under the bridge out of Kokiri Forest, plant a Magic Bean in the soft soil where you found a Gold Skulltula.
In the hidden grove with the Business Scrubs (north from the Zora's River shortcut, then west), plant one in the soil by the tree.
Drop into the grotto there to the Forest Stage. Show the Mask of Truth on stage for the biggest Deku Nut upgrade.
steps.tip: If you haven't yet, wear the Skull Mask on stage too.

steps.text: The guard won't let you cross the bridge yet. At the small wooden plank over the water, play the Sun's Song for night and drop down to the Gold Skulltula under the bridge.
Grab the Cucco nearby and glide across the valley to the big chest on the far wall. It holds a Piece of Heart.
With the Cucco, float down to the big alcove by the river, where a Gerudo keeps a cow. Plant a Magic Bean in the soil there, then drop a bug for a Gold Skulltula.
steps.tip: Play Epona's Song for the cow to get free milk.

steps.text: Follow the alcove north to the big waterfall. Climb the path behind it to a Piece of Heart.
Let the river carry you to Lake Hylia. Walk onto the rope bridge from the laboratory, play the Sun's Song and look back to Boomerang a Gold Skulltula.
steps.tip: Kaepora Gaebora can fly you from the lake back toward Hyrule Castle.

chapters.title: Seven years later
chapters.summary: Wake up as an adult, win the Hookshot from Dampé's ghost and fight through the Sacred Forest Meadow to the Forest Temple.

steps.text: Link wakes in the Chamber of Sages. Rauru, the Sage of Light, explains that seven years have passed and Ganondorf took the Triforce.
You need the help of six sages waiting in temples around Hyrule. Rauru adds his power first and gives you the Light Medallion.
Back in the Temple of Time, Sheik tells you of five temples, starting with the one in the deep forest. First, Sheik sends you to Kakariko for a useful tool.
Castle Town is in ruins and full of ReDeads. Slip past behind them, or play the Sun's Song to freeze them before you fight.
In the guard house by the exit, the Poe Collector pays for Poes in bottles. Big Poes roam Hyrule Field, but you can't hunt them yet.
Head east to Kakariko Village. The well is dry now, but its opening is too small for an adult.
In the windmill, take out your ocarina in front of the angry Music Man. He plays the tune a boy played seven years ago; repeat it to learn the Song of Storms.
Villagers say Dampé has died and his ghost haunts the graveyard. His diary in the hut says he buried a treasure with himself.
His grave is at the northwest edge, by a lone tree, and gives off purple smoke. Pull the headstone back and drop in.
Dampé's ghost challenges you to a race. You don't have to win; just stay close, or the door ahead shuts and you start over.
Go straight, then right and left while dodging his fireballs, and climb the ledge. Keep straight, turn the corner and take two lefts; skip the Green Rupees.
Turn right into the room of stones and hug the back right corner, then go left and right.
In the foggy room, run to the back, not left where ReDeads sleep. In the back right alcove, climb the left raised platform.
Go left into the big room with the road around a pit and sprint to the end. Make it before the door closes and Dampé gives you the Hookshot.
Hookshot the target at the edge of the crumbling stairs. The tunnel beyond comes out high in the windmill.
On the windmill's high platform, ride the turning platform to the Piece of Heart on your right.
Kokiri Forest is now full of Deku Babas, Skulltulas and Scrubs. Your old sword teacher, near the path to the Lost Woods, says Saria went to the Forest Temple and never came back.
In the Lost Woods, go right, left, then right to the Zora's River shortcut. Stay away from the Skull Kids; they attack now.
Mido won't let a stranger pass. Play Saria's Song and he steps aside.
Keep following the maze to the Sacred Forest Meadow.
Moblins patrol the narrow paths and charge when they see you, knocking you into the water. Wait for one to pass, then Hookshot or slash its back.
steps.tip: A single hit from behind takes a Moblin down. Hide in the side alcoves while they charge.

steps.text: The last two patrol the east and west corridors before the long stairway.
The Great Moblin's mace sends a shockwave down the left, middle or right of the stairs. After each slam, zigzag to another lane, then roll behind him and slash.
At the top, where Saria used to play, Sheik appears and teaches you the Minuet of Forest. It warps you to the pedestal here.
Hookshot the target high above to get into the Forest Temple.
Just outside Kakariko, play the Song of Storms at the propeller plant by the wheelbarrow. Beat the two ReDeads in the dark grotto for a Purple Rupee.
Take the Cucco Lady's egg. It hatches into a Pocket Cucco at dawn and starts the adult trading quest.
If you planted a Magic Bean in the graveyard as a child, ride the floating plant to the ledge with a Piece of Heart.
Race Dampé again and finish in under a minute for another Piece of Heart. Keep sprinting the whole way.
At night, left of Impa's House past the Cucco pen, Hookshot the high vines. From there, Hookshot the Gold Skulltula over the yard with the cow stable.
Back in the ruined town, walk up the road toward Ganon's Castle. Hookshot the Gold Skulltula on the far side of the broken archway.
Ingo now runs the ranch for Ganondorf. Hookshot the vines of the old stone tower and climb to a chest with a Business Scrub Seed.
By day, pay Ingo 20 Rupees to ride. Play Epona's Song in the pen and Epona comes to you. Carrots give bursts of speed and refill over time.
Talk to Ingo on horseback and race him twice. Hug the inside line and spread out your carrots on the straights. Win the second race to keep Epona.
Ingo locks the gate. Build up speed and jump Epona over one of the low fences in the ranch wall.
In Kakariko, wake Talon with the Pocket Cucco. He goes home and takes the ranch back.
Back at the ranch, beat Malon's obstacle course in under 40 seconds. She sends a cow to your house in Kokiri Forest.
Return the Pocket Cucco to the Cucco Lady. She gives you Cojiro, her brother's silent Cucco.
The lake has dried up. Play the same song you made up as a child for Bonooru. It becomes the Scarecrow's Song and Pierre will appear wherever you see a puff of straw.
Ride the bean plant by the laboratory and jump off onto its roof. Climb to the balcony at the top for a Piece of Heart; watch for diving Guays.

sections.title: Kokiri Forest and the Lost Woods

steps.text: If Malon sent the cow, play Epona's Song for it in your house for Lon Lon Milk.
At night, Hookshot the Gold Skulltula at the top of the House of the Twins.
Take the first left in the Lost Woods. Show Cojiro to the man sitting there and he hands you an Odd Mushroom.
You have 4 minutes to bring it to Granny behind Kakariko's Potion Shop. Ride Epona, or cut through the Goron City shortcut and down the mountain.
steps.tip: Go through the main Potion Shop and out its side door to reach her.

steps.text: Bring her potion back to the Lost Woods. The man is gone; Fado takes it and gives you the Poacher's Saw.
In the tunnel above the bridge to Hyrule Field, ride the bean plant to a high chest with a Purple Rupee.
Past Mido, go left to the hidden grove. Ride the bean plant to a high ledge with a Gold Skulltula.
Know the Scarecrow's Song? Play it at the start of the maze and Hookshot to Pierre to walk along the tops of the walls.
By the meadow entrance, play the Song of Storms at the propeller plant. Beat the two Wolfos in the grotto for a Purple Rupee.
After the Great Moblin, go back to the Fairy Fountain in the ruins before the stairs. Climb the ladder to the top and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula by the big tree root on the east side.

chapters.title: Forest Temple
chapters.summary: Win back the four flames from the Poe Sisters, defeat Phantom Ganon and wake Saria as the Sage of the Forest.

steps.text: Two Wolfos attack as you walk in. Back off from their swipes and hit them when they turn, or use a spin attack.
The front door is locked. Climb the vines on the east tree and cross the long branch to the other tree. The chest there has a Small Key.
From the branches, look back at the top of the vine wall and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula.
Unlock the door. Inside, a big Skulltula blocks the way; hit it on its back.

sections.title: The foyer and the Dungeon Map

steps.text: In the foyer, the four Poe Sisters steal the flames from the torches around the lift and seal it. You need all four flames back.
Go up the stairs toward the green window. On the inner wall by a blue window, Hookshot the Gold Skulltula.
Take the north door under the green window. Raise your shield against the Blue Bubble to put out its flames, then strike.
Two Stalfos lock you in the next room. After their two side swings, hit once and dodge the overhead blow. Sidestep when one backs off to leap.
Beating both makes a chest appear with a Small Key.
Back in the foyer, go northwest on the lower floor. Play the Song of Time at the blue block to clear the door to the courtyard.
Hookshot the Skullwalltulas off the vines on the right and climb to the balcony. Hookshot the target on the north balcony.
Step on the switch there to drain the well on the island. Jump into the well and follow the tunnel to the other courtyard.
A chest in the tunnel holds a Small Key.
Climb the ladder into the east courtyard. Reflect the Octoroks' rocks, then Hookshot across the water to the big chest with the Dungeon Map.
Cross back over the moat and take the door to the foyer. The switch there opens the gate on the blue side.

sections.title: The red wing and the Fairy Bow

steps.text: Unlock the red door and get past the Blue Bubble in the hall.
In the tall room, a Wallmaster drops on you. Run when the light above you turns red, then slash the hand after it lands.
steps.tip: If it grabs you, it sends you back to the temple entrance.

steps.text: Climb the ladder. Follow the yellow arrows: push the stone block east, then south, then go around and push it west into its slot.
Where the block started there is now a ladder to the second floor. Push the block up there south as far as it goes.
Go back down, climb the other ledge and push that block east into its slot. Climb up to the third floor.
Hookshot the floating Blue Bubbles. The switch on the west side starts a lift, a handy shortcut. Then unlock the north door.
The hallway and the red chapel beyond are twisted. Hop across the tilted platforms, watch for a Wallmaster and leave by the east doorway.
steps.tip: If you fall, a ladder takes you back to the middle platform.

steps.text: A Poe hides in the paintings of the stairwell. Ignore her for now and go down to the door on the second floor.
Stalfos wait around a pit of poison: one, then two more. Fight near the walls and let them come to you. A Hookshot mid-leap knocks them down.
Open the big chest for the Fairy Bow. Break the pots first if you need hearts.
Shoot the eye above the east door to return to the stairwell.
Shoot the Poe's three paintings from afar: one on each side of the second-floor landing and one at the top of the stairs.
Jo appears at the bottom. Dodge her spinning torch charge, then hit her while she is dizzy. She drops the red flame.
A chest appears with a Small Key.
Cross the bow room to the blue wing. Shoot the three paintings on the second and third floor landings to bring out Beth.
Beth fights like Jo. Win and take the blue flame, then open the big chest for the Compass.
The door on the top floor of the blue wing is locked. Go back through the red wing and the twisted chapel to the start of the twisted hallway.
Shoot the eye in the frame there. The hallway and the red chapel turn back to normal.
In the red chapel, open the big blue chest by the hole in the floor for the Boss Key.
steps.tip: Side trip: in the block room, follow the yellow arrows on the second floor to a northeast balcony. Shoot the eye there for a Purple Rupee.

sections.title: The Floormaster and the blue wing

steps.text: Drop into the hole and climb out of the pool fast to deal with the Blue Bubbles. Exit south onto a balcony over the west courtyard.
Follow the narrow ledge around the doorway to the south. Hookshot the Gold Skulltula on the wall just past it.
The west room seals you in with a Floormaster. Block its green flames with your shield, then strike.
When it splits into three small hands, kill them all quickly or they merge again. Din's Fire helps. A chest appears with a Small Key.
The south door is a shortcut up to the third floor. Shoot the eye to twist the red wing again, then head to the blue wing.
Unlock the door at the top of Beth's stairwell. Go through the blue chapel, up a ladder, shoot the Green Bubbles and unlock the far door.
The eye above the door is frozen. Step on the switch to light the torch and shoot an arrow through the flame at the eye. The blue wing twists.
In the twisted blue chapel, drop through the pit to the first floor.
Take the side door out to the courtyard and push the stone block to open a shortcut.
Look up at the gust of straw and play the Scarecrow's Song. Hookshot to Pierre and take the Gold Skulltula next to him.
steps.tip: You need the Scarecrow's Song from Lake Hylia.

steps.text: Back inside, the ceiling falls in a checkerboard pattern. Stand under the rays of light, where it does not fall, and move while it rises.
A shadow in the light means a Skulltula is about to drop. Press the switch under the light on the right to open the far door.
Shoot the green Poe in the wall painting. She jumps into the painting on the block and scrambles it into pieces.
Slide the blocks to rebuild her picture. Leave out the head piece with the dark tassel, the one that never moves. The lighter one goes top right.
Amy can spin at you several times before she gets dizzy. Keep dodging and only attack when she is dazed. She drops the green flame.
In the hall, Meg's big portrait blocks the way. Stay by the door and shoot her when she comes into the frame.
Follow her to the foyer. She splits into four and only the real one takes damage. First round: shoot the one with the purple torch.
Second round: only the real Meg has a lit torch. Third round: all torches burn, but the real Meg has wider eyes. Hit her after each arrow.
With all four flames back, the lift works. Ride it down to the basement.
Before turning anything, enter the open doorway to the south. Kill the Skulltula, then look inside the alcove for a Gold Skulltula.
Push the handholds in the walls counterclockwise. When the opening reaches the northwest, step on the switch to light a torch in a wall window.
Keep turning until the lit torch window sits in front of the frozen eye to the east. Shoot an arrow through the flame at the eye.
The gate to the north opens. Use the Boss Key on the door beyond.
Phantom Ganon rides out of the six paintings with fake copies. The fakes turn back; the real one jumps out and strikes with lightning.
The real one holds his spear in his right hand, on the left side of the painting as you look. Shoot that one with the bow as he gets close.
He adds more copies as the fight goes on. After two or three arrows he leaves the horse and floats above you.
Now arrows do nothing. Swing your sword at his energy ball to send it back, and keep the rally going until it hits him.
When he falls to the ground, run in with jump attacks and spin attacks. Watch for a sudden dive instead of a ball.
The rallies get longer. After his third fall, finish him with the Master Sword and take the Heart Container.
Step into the blue light. In the Chamber of Sages, Saria wakes as the Sage of the Forest and gives you the Forest Medallion.
You arrive at the Great Deku Tree's grove and meet the Deku Tree Sprout, who tells you about Link's past.

sections.title: Back to the Temple of Time

steps.text: Go to the Temple of Time. Sheik teaches you the Prelude of Light, which warps you back there whenever you like.
Put the Master Sword back in its pedestal to become a child again. Pull it out to return to the future.
steps.tip: As a child you cannot use the Hookshot or the bow. You get the Slingshot and Boomerang back.

steps.text: East of the castle moat in Hyrule Field, read the Fairy Thoughts on the tree by the bombable grotto for a password. As a child, give it to the Business Scrub inside and buy a Heart Piece for 100 Rupees.
As an adult, read the Fairy Thoughts behind the rock outcrop near the Gerudo Valley entrance. As a child, the chest there now opens and holds a Heart Piece.
By the tall tree where you met Talon outside Hyrule Castle, play the Song of Storms at the propeller plant. The grotto has a Gold Skulltula.
At the frogs in Zora's River, play the Song of Time and then the Song of Storms for a Heart Piece.
Then win the frogs' fast note game, playing the note shown over each frog, for another Heart Piece.
Bomb the grotto by the big Peahat in the marsh north of Lake Hylia and kill the Skullwalltula inside. As an adult, break the crate there for a Gold Skulltula.
With 50 Gold Skulltula tokens, the father in Kakariko's House of Skulltula gives you a Heart Piece.
Kakariko's shooting gallery is open for adults. Hit all 10 swinging targets with the bow, 15 shots max, for the Bigger Quiver.
steps.tip: Hitting 8 or 9 targets gives you a free retry.

steps.text: Glowing beds, like the one in Link's house, now take you to the Hall of Fallen Foes, where you can rematch any boss you have beaten.

chapters.title: Disaster in Goron City
chapters.summary: Climb Death Mountain, get the Goron Tunic from Darunia's son and learn the Bolero of Fire in the crater.

steps.text: Boulders now roll down the trail. Let one pass, hug the right side and duck into the alcoves until you reach the first ledge.
steps.tip: Your bombs cannot break the big grey rocks along the way.

steps.text: For the next row of boulders, stay on the left wall. Enter the tunnel to Goron City.
The city is almost empty. A young Goron rolls around the floor just below the entrance and will not stop.
Pick a Bomb Flower from the group by the rope bridge, right of the entrance, and drop it so it blows up as he rolls past.
steps.tip: Drop down first to scare him into rolling the other way. He slows down when he turns, which makes the timing easier.

steps.text: Talk to him. He is Darunia's son, named Link after you. Ganondorf took the Gorons to the Fire Temple, and Darunia went after them.
Offer to help and he gives you the Goron Tunic, which protects you from the heat of the crater.
On the floor where you met him, go to the north side. Below the central platform, a Gold Skulltula sits on a rocky outcrop.
In Darunia's chamber, pull the big statue at the back away from the wall to open the path to the crater.
Wear the Goron Tunic before you go in, or the heat keeps draining your hearts.
Grey rocks block the path toward the summit for now. Hookshot across the broken bridge to the east.
Sheik is waiting and teaches you the Bolero of Fire, which warps you back to the crater.
When you are ready, head north into the Fire Temple.
If you planted a Magic Bean outside Dodongo's Cavern as a child, ride the plant up to the Heart Piece on the high ledge.
In Dodongo's Cavern, take the first hall east. Play the Scarecrow's Song at the gust of straw and Hookshot up to Pierre for a Gold Skulltula.
On the right just before the Goron City tunnel, play the Song of Storms at the propeller plant. Beat the Baby Dodongos in the grotto for Rupees.
On the top floor of Goron City, Medigoron sells the Giant's Knife for 200 Rupees. It hits hard but breaks after a while.
On the floor below the entrance, a small tunnel in the southwest leads to a lava room. Hookshot over the lava to a grotto with a sign puzzle.
Counting from the left, cut sign 3, then sign 5, then sign 1. Leave 2 and 4. A chest with a Purple Rupee appears.
steps.tip: Use the Master Sword here; a long blade can hit the wrong sign. The puzzle resets after you leave the area.

steps.text: The Goron Shop near Darunia's chamber also sells the Goron Tunic, in case you ever lose yours.
As a child, warp in with the Bolero of Fire and plant a Magic Bean in the soft soil by the temple platform. Drop bugs on it for a Gold Skulltula.
steps.tip: Be quick: as a child the heat hurts you the whole time.

steps.text: Back as an adult, ride the bean plant around the crater to the Heart Piece on top of a tall rock pillar.
From the low platform east of the temple entrance, play the Scarecrow's Song twice to reach a high ledge with a ring of Rupees and a Purple Rupee.
If you skipped the crater summit as a child, it still has two Heart Pieces and a Gold Skulltula to pick up.

chapters.title: Fire Temple
chapters.summary: Free the nine imprisoned Gorons, find the Megaton Hammer and defeat Volvagia so Darunia can wake as the Sage of Fire.

steps.text: Wear the Goron Tunic. In the entry hall, take the upper left door to the west.
Darunia is there. He goes after Volvagia alone and asks you to free nine imprisoned Gorons. Each one leaves you a Small Key.
Head south and hop across the platforms over the lava. Step on the switch to free the first Goron and open his chest for a Small Key.
Unlock the east door of the entry hall. Shoot the Fire Keese from afar so they do not knock you off a platform.
Go north across the stone platforms, quickly, since some sink. Free the second Goron and take the Small Key.
Keep east along the north side. The platform below the northeast ledge rises on a jet of lava. Play the Song of Time at the blue block up there.
Block the Flying Tiles with your shield. Then Hookshot the Like Like to stun it, hit it and back away before it can swallow you.
steps.tip: A Like Like can steal your Hylian Shield or Goron Tunic. Beat it to get the item back, or reload your last autosave.

steps.text: Check the back wall of that room for a Gold Skulltula.
Cross to the south side of the lava room and bomb the cracked wall. Free the third Goron and take the Small Key.
steps.tip: In the southwest, the second of two lava platforms shoots up to a hidden ledge with pots of Rupees.

sections.title: The boulder maze and the Dungeon Map

steps.text: Cross the long bridge east and unlock the door. Pass the fire jet and unlock the second door, then climb the mesh wall. Keese hide on the walls.
Push the stone block at the top over the fire jet, then hop on it and ride it up to the second floor.
Shoot or slash the Torch Slugs. At the top of the steps, hit the blue switch to move the wall of fire to the back.
Pull the stone block out of the corner alcove and climb it past where the fire was. Hit the switch again with the bow or Hookshot and climb to the third floor.
steps.tip: A Goron is locked up nearby, but you cannot free him from this side yet.

steps.text: In the boulder maze, keep to the right wall going north and bomb the cracked wall for a Gold Skulltula.
Keep along the north walls to an alcove with the fourth Goron. Free him and take the Small Key.
Weave past the boulders to the south side. The big chest in the alcove there holds the Dungeon Map.

sections.title: The Compass and the high platforms

steps.text: Unlock the door on the west side of the maze. In the passage, shoot the eye above the west door and go through for the Compass.
Take the south door. A wall of fire chases you across the walkways over the lava. Climb the ledge on the left and let it pass.
Drop down and follow behind the fire to the north side. Push the big block back into the maze room to reach the high platforms.
Hop north, then look back up at the gust of straw. Play the Scarecrow's Song, Hookshot to Pierre and jump to the platform that rises.
Climb the mesh wall to the top floor. A Gold Skulltula waits on the wall by the door.
Inside, Hookshot another Gold Skulltula on the inner wall around the pit.
steps.tip: The switch raises two Hookshot pillars for a short time. Reach the three chests for 90 Rupees.

steps.text: Back on the high platforms, bomb the cracked central one. Climb down the mesh to the second floor and free the fifth Goron for a Small Key.
Climb back up and jump across to the south end of the platforms. Free the sixth Goron and take the Small Key.
Go back to the fire wall room and outrun the wall to the east door.
Posts in this room shoot hidden walls of flame when you get close. Move slowly. Bomb the door that wiggles; it is a trap.
Work your way north to the seventh Goron. Free him and take the Small Key.
The west is blocked from here. Go to the south side and unlock the door into the central chamber, then head north.
A switch in the middle needs a weight. Pick up a small stone block from the platform to the northeast and throw it toward the switch.
Set the block on the switch. Every fire trap in the room shuts off.

sections.title: Flare Dancer and the Megaton Hammer

steps.text: Unlock the next door to face the Flare Dancer. Hookshot its core out of the flames, then chase the small body and slash it.
Cut it off by running the other way or with Bomb Flowers. Avoid the blue flames when it recharges. A lift to the fourth floor opens.
Drop a Bomb Flower onto the switch below to stop the flame jets. Throw a second one, then climb the mesh wall while the jets are down.
On the fifth floor, step on the switch to raise a narrow path. Run up before the flames return and open the chest for the Megaton Hammer.
steps.tip: On the high ledge to the south, play the Sun's Song at the fairy writing to heal.

steps.text: Hammer the raised button over the grate on the north side and drop through the hole.
Smash the segmented statue blocking the door with a sideways swing. Press the button in the next room to lower platforms to the third floor.
In the middle of the big west room, smash the grey rocks above the cell. Play the Song of Time at the blue block to open a hole.
Drop down and hammer the rusted switch to free the eighth Goron. Take the Small Key.

sections.title: The ninth Goron and the Boss Key

steps.text: Hammer the big panel next to the cell. The pillar falls all the way to the first floor, in front of the boss door.
In the entry hall, smash the big statue and unlock the door behind it. Hammer the slugs in the next room until the far door opens.
Block the Flying Tiles, then deal with the Like Like with the Hookshot or Bombs. Smash the grey rock at the end of the room for a Gold Skulltula.
Smash the statue at the next door for a Flare Dancer rematch. After pulling its core out, a hammer slam stuns it. Watch the green flames.
Go south to the last Goron, the one you saw at the start. Free him and open the big blue chest for the Boss Key.
Go back through the entry hall and cross the fallen pillar to the boss door.
steps.tip: Hookshot to the high ledge on the north side first. Its pots restore health and magic, and there is a Fairy to bottle.

steps.text: Volvagia pops out of the lava holes. Run in and do a jump attack with the Megaton Hammer to break its helmet, then slash its head.
When it flies and breathes fire, run sideways to its path. Stay off the burning spots it leaves on the floor.
Several holes bubble as fake-outs. Stay close to the groups of holes so you can reach its head fast.
When rocks rain from the ceiling, raise your shield and strafe so they hit the front of it.
Keep hammering its head each time it surfaces. Its last attack lays two fire trails. Finish it and take the Heart Container.
Step into the blue light. In the Chamber of Sages, Darunia wakes as the Sage of Fire and gives you the Fire Medallion.
In the crater, smash the grey rock to the right of the Goron City exit. Two Lizalfos in the grotto guard a chest with a Purple Rupee.
Smash the grey rocks on the south walkway toward the summit. Beside the broken bridge, one hides a Great Fairy Fountain.
Play Zelda's Lullaby and pay 200 Rupees. The Great Fairy doubles your magic.
Biggoron now sits on the summit, but he is not taking orders yet.
Climb down from the summit to the slope toward Goron City and smash the new grey rock. At night a Gold Skulltula is behind it.
Still at night, in the big tunnel to Goron City, smash the grey rock left of the balcony over Dodongo's Cavern for another Gold Skulltula.
In Goron City, smash the grey rocks in the rock room on the northwest of the top floor to reach a chest with a Red Rupee.

chapters.title: The frozen Zora
chapters.summary: Find out why Zora's Domain froze, clear the Ice Cavern for the Iron Boots and thaw King Zora for the Zora Tunic.

steps.text: Head up Zora's River. If you planted a Magic Bean by the Bean Seller as a child, ride the floating plant to skip most of the river.
Zora's Domain is frozen solid and empty. Climb the stairs to King Zora, who is stuck in a block of red ice that nothing can melt yet.
Walk past King Zora's seat to reach Zora's Fountain.
Jabu-Jabu is gone and the fountain is full of icebergs. Follow the winding ice bridge north to the cave, blocking the Octoroks' shots.
Partway along the bridge, small ice floes lead east. Hop across them carefully and take the Piece of Heart on the last big floe.
Walk slowly through the corridors. Icicles drop as you get close, and they land before you reach them if you take your time.
Remember where the chunks of red ice are. You will come back to melt them later.
In the big icy room, defeat the three Freezards between the spike traps. The Hookshot or Din's Fire finishes them fast.
steps.tip: A Freezard locks in place while it breathes. Stand so a spike trap is between you and it, and its breath freezes the trap for a while.

steps.text: The gate opens. Go up the corridor to a room with a spinning ice blade and five Silver Rupees that open the far gate.
Drop down and go left. Slash the wall of stalagmites to reveal the first Silver Rupee.
Three more float around the blade. Move counterclockwise and jump past the blade, never toward the middle of it.
Climb the ledges on the north side. Wait for the blade to pass, then jump south to the last Silver Rupee.
From that ledge, look south: a Gold Skulltula sits high on the wall above the stalagmites. Stand under it and Hookshot it.
In the room north of the gate, shoot the Ice Keese with the Bow first. They freeze you on contact unless your shield is up.
Hookshot up to the Freezard on the raised platform, then jump north to the stalagmite backed by red ice. Slash it to free a font of Blue Fire.
Empty at least two bottles and fill them with Blue Fire. Keep them topped up from now on.
steps.tip: Red ice on a low platform to the south-east hides a pot with a Blue Rupee.

steps.text: Take the high path to the north-west, deal with the Freezard and melt the red ice. The chest holds the map.
Go back to the blade room and melt the red ice blocking the east corridor.
Get past the spike traps and the Freezard to three alcoves. The south one has a Blue Fire font for refills.
Slash the stalagmites in the east alcove, watch for Keese, and open the chest for the compass.
Turn around at the chest. A Gold Skulltula hides behind the low ice column on the north side; Hookshot it.
Fill your bottles again. The red ice chunks near the entrance hold pots with a Red Rupee, a fairy and a Magic Jar if you want them.
Melt the red ice on the west passage of the blade room. Beyond it, five Silver Rupees are spread around a room with a sliding ice block.
Shoot the Ice Keese first. Then push the block west, climb the pillar it stops at and take the first Silver Rupee.
Push the block north so it stops under a ledge of red ice. Climb up and melt it for the second one.
Push the block into a pit; a new one appears where it started. Push it south and climb the pillar for the third.
From the east side of the platform, look up across the gap you walked around. Get close to the edge and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula.
Push the block west to one more tall pillar for the fourth Silver Rupee. The fifth is on a low platform just to its right.
Reset the block in a pit, then push it south, west, north, east and south. It stops under the ledge by the open gate; climb up and go south.
steps.tip: A small chest with a Red Rupee waits on the north-west ledge. Push the block north, west, south and west to reach the Blue Fire alcove, then play the Song of Time there.

steps.text: Defeat the Freezards and melt the red ice in the last doorway. A high alcove to the east has more Blue Fire if you ran out.
The White Wolfos freezes you with its claws, then slashes twice. Keep your shield up or stay out of reach.
Dodge its swings until it overswings and spins. Hit its exposed back, then back off and wait for the next attack.
Take the Iron Boots. They let you sink to the bottom of deep water and keep your footing in strong wind.
Sheik tells you the Zora are frozen except Ruto, who went ahead to the Water Temple. Learn the Serenade of Water, which warps you to Lake Hylia.
Fill a bottle with Blue Fire, then drop into the pool to the south that leads out.
Put on the Iron Boots to sink and walk out through the tunnel to Zora's Fountain. You lose air underwater without the right tunic, so be quick.
Take the boots off to float up and go back to the Domain. Pour the Blue Fire on King Zora; he gives you the Zora Tunic.
steps.tip: With the Zora Tunic and the Iron Boots on together, you can breathe and walk underwater for as long as you like.

steps.text: Play the Serenade of Water to warp to the island in the middle of the dried up Lake Hylia.
When you are ready, sink into the pool below the island in front of the temple. Hookshot the target above the gate to open it.

Two Gold Skulltulas appear on Zora's River at night: one high on the west wall seen from the south ledge of the central island, one on the west cliffs seen from the stairs by the falls. Hookshot both.
In King Zora's chamber, take the side path north to the frozen waterfall. A Gold Skulltula crawls high on the left wall; Hookshot it.
Wear the Zora Tunic and the Iron Boots and sink into the deep pool of Zora's Fountain. A Piece of Heart sits in a ring of Rupees at the bottom.
The fishing pond by Lake Hylia is still open. Ride the bean plant from the laboratory or use the Scarecrow's Song under the docks to reach it.
Catch a fish over 60 cm, usually near the middle of the pond, for the Golden Scale. Pull the way the fish swims until it tires, then reel in.
steps.tip: A Hylian Loach lives at the bottom of the pond and is worth 50 Rupees. The sinking lure helps.

steps.text: With the Golden Scale, dive to the bottom of the Lakeside Laboratory pool without the Iron Boots, then talk to the scientist for a Piece of Heart.
Then sink to the bottom of the same pool with the Iron Boots and roll into the wooden crate to free a Gold Skulltula.
Thawing King Zora is also a step of the adult trading quest that ends with Biggoron's Sword.

chapters.title: The Water Temple
chapters.summary: Change the water level three times to work through the temple, beat Dark Link for the Longshot and defeat Morpha.

sections.title: Find Ruto and drain the temple

steps.text: Take the Iron Boots off as you enter and swim up to the platform. The water fills the main room up to the top floor (3F) around a tall central tower.
steps.tip: In the remake, one press swaps the Iron Boots on and off, so you can switch between sinking and swimming quickly.

steps.text: Shoot the Tektites, then put the Iron Boots on and sink to the bottom floor (1F). Block the rolling Spikes with your shield and finish them with the Hookshot.
Find the doorway with two glowing blue pillars. The sign above it shows only the bottom tier lit, which means this room lowers the water.
Inside, Princess Ruto explains she came to stop the monster here, then swims off.
Take the boots off and follow the blue lights up to the top. The big chest there holds the map.
Play Zelda's Lullaby at the Triforce mural nearby. The water drops to the lowest level (1F).
Drop down the pit to the small pool on 1F. Shoot an arrow through the lit torch into each of the two unlit braziers, or use Din's Fire, to open the east door.
The door locks behind you. Block the three Spikes and slash them when their spikes pull in. The chest that appears holds a Small Key.
Back in the main room, bomb the cracked wall on the south side of the tower and follow the passage down to the west.
Sink to B1 with the Iron Boots. Block the Shell Blade's charge, then Hookshot it when it opens its shell.
Swim up past it and step on the switch. A statue rises with a Hookshot target to cross the gap.
Shoot the Like Like above with the Bow before it gets close. Defeating it makes the big chest with the compass appear.
steps.tip: The Zora Shop is frozen, so you can't buy a new Zora Tunic. If a Like Like swallows you, kill it right away to get your gear back.

sections.title: Raise the water to the middle

steps.text: Go to the west side of the tower and push the big stone block into the pool below. Sink after it and defeat the Shell Blade.
Swim up to the north opening and drop into the whirlpool. Sink onto the narrow serpent platform and Hookshot the switch in the serpent head's mouth.
Toggle the boots on and off to drift through the gate it opens. Defeat the two Shell Blades past it and climb to the chest with a Small Key.
Unlock the door with green pillars to enter the base of the tower. Hookshot the target above and play Zelda's Lullaby at the mural. The water rises to the middle level (2F).
The floating block in the tower rose with the water and left a hole. Sink through it to the basement and defeat the three Spikes.
Hookshot the green switch overhead. A gate in the low ceiling opens and drops a Shell Blade; defeat it and swim up into the chamber.
Search the walls of this small chamber for a Gold Skulltula and Hookshot it.
Swim back up and leave the tower on 2F. Go east to Ruto's room and sink to the bottom. The cracked wall halfway up is now dry; bomb it.
Cut down the Shell Blades inside, then check the wall behind you for a Gold Skulltula.
Swim to the alcove at the water line east of the tower and bomb its cracked wall. Sink into the north-east passage, blocking the Stingers and Hookshotting them.
At the geyser room, Hookshot the switch in the small pool to lower the geyser. Stand on it, hit the switch again and ride up to the chest with a Small Key.

sections.title: Raise the water to the top

steps.text: Follow the floating blocks on the west side of the tower to the locked door with red pillars and open it.
Hit the switch to lower the geyser and defeat the Tektite that comes down with it. Stand on the geyser and shoot the switch to ride up to 3F.
Play Zelda's Lullaby at the mural. The water rises back to the top level (3F).
Hop down to the tower platform and look back at the ledge. Play the Scarecrow's Song there and Pierre gives you a quick way back up to this mural.
Take the second locked door on the west side. Clear the Keese, then slide down onto the moving platforms in the pit.
Hookshot from target to target on the far platforms before they sink. Rest on the fixed platform at the side, then Hookshot from the highest platform up to the ledge.
In the next room, shoot the Tektites in the pit. Hit the blue switch to raise the statues, then Hookshot to the closest one to the west.
Hit the switch again to lower the north statue, then Hookshot to the target left of it and walk past on the narrow ledge.
Raise the statues and Hookshot to the north-east one. Hit the switch twice more so the statue drops, stand on it and ride it up to the high ledge.
Cross the misty room with the lone tree. The exit is sealed and Dark Link waits by the tree.
His third slash leaves a red trail. Dodge it and hit him while he recovers. Don't stab carelessly: he blocks everything and can stand on your sword.
steps.tip: Din's Fire hurts and stuns him early in the fight. After he fades and returns, he backflips away from slow attacks.

steps.text: In the second phase he stabs twice and then jumps; sidestep the jump, and watch for a delayed jump meant to bait you. When he rolls or charges a spin attack, backflip away.
Right after his spin attack or jump, move in with a jump attack, then back off again. Repeat until he is gone for good.
Go on through to the chest with the Longshot. It reaches targets much farther away than the Hookshot.
