Stand on the platform behind the chest and Longshot to the high ledge. Drop down the waterfall into the cave river that leads back to the entrance.
Avoid the whirlpools: put the Iron Boots on to hold your ground and climb the ledges around them.
Where the river turns south, look behind you. Longshot the Gold Skulltula high on a rock pillar while wearing the boots.
Walk through the middle of the last two whirlpools to the south-east corner. Shoot the eye target on the big gate and Longshot through before it shuts.
steps.tip: A pot on the ledges right after the whirlpools holds a fairy for a bottle.

steps.text: Back in the main room, sink to Ruto's room and lower the water to 1F. Climb the inside of the tower again and raise the water to 2F at its mural.
Longshot the target at the very top of the tower's ceiling. A Gold Skulltula is on the other side of it.
With the water at 2F, go out on the tower balcony to the north. Shoot the eye target on the far wall and Longshot to the target that appears.
In the north room, sink in the pool on the left and pull the stone block back as far as it goes.
Climb out and Longshot the ceiling target in the waterfall alcove right of the fence. You drop behind the block; push it north to reach the chest with the last Small Key.
In the main room, sink to the bottom on the north side and drop into the basement pit heading north. Longshot to the far door and unlock it.
Shoot the Tektites first. Time your crossing between the rolling boulders, sinking and swimming between ledges, and stay clear of the whirlpools.
In the next room, drop Bombs into the pool to clear the Stingers. Then bomb the three cracked walls on the left.
Push the stone block from the middle wall into the pool. It lands on a switch and raises the water to the high ledge.
Step on the switch to raise the geysers and cross them, shooting any Tektites. Take the door near the gated big chest into the boulder waterway.
Wait for a boulder to pass, then run east and north to the alcove door. Defeat the Shell Blade and open the big chest for the Boss Key.
Back by the rolling boulders, find the small waterfall that boulders don't use. Longshot the Gold Skulltula above it before the next boulder comes.
Raise the water to 3F, using Pierre from the south-west corner as a shortcut or the red door. Longshot the far target on the north side of the tower.
Wear the Iron Boots up the slope with rushing water and slip around the bouncing spike traps. The boss door is at the top.
Morpha is a column of water with a small core inside. Stay on the platforms; you can't hurt it underwater.
Keep moving when it rises. It slams up to three times, then has to recover. Longshot the core out and slash it.
When it starts sweeping wide circles, Longshot to a target on the wall to escape. If it catches you, mash attack to break free.
Once it tires, run back, pull the core out again and keep slashing.
In the last phase, tendrils rise in every corner. Dodge the stray slams, find the one with the core, bait its slam and pull the core out until Morpha dies.
Take the Heart Container as the water drains.
Step into the blue light. In the Chamber of Sages, Ruto, now the Sage of Water, gives you the Water Medallion.
Lake Hylia fills up again and the Zora thaw. Read the plaque by the temple pedestal on the island.
Wait for the sun to rise in the east and shoot an arrow at it. Swim to the small island where the light lands and take the Fire Arrows.
steps.tip: Fire Arrows set things alight without a torch, but each shot costs a lot of magic.

steps.text: A strange glow is rising over Kakariko Village. Head there next.
Play the Sun's Song to bring night, then Longshot the vines at the top of the dead tree on the island. A Gold Skulltula is up there.
With the lake full again, the fishing pond and the rest of Lake Hylia are easier to reach. You can also swim the shortcut back to Zora's Domain.

chapters.title: Darkness under Kakariko
chapters.summary: Learn the Nocturne of Shadow, drain Kakariko's well as a child and take the Lenses of Truth from Dead Hand.

steps.text: Smoke and fire are rising over Kakariko Village. Ride there and find Sheik standing in front of the well.
A shadow creature bursts out of the well, knocks you down and flees into the Shadow Temple.
Sheik explains that Impa sealed the creature under the well and has gone after it. Learn the Nocturne of Shadow, which warps you to a hidden part of the graveyard.
The Shadow Temple is full of traps you can only see with the Eye of Truth, and its door stays shut for now.
Talk to the old man in the village. Someone with the Eye of Truth once lived where the well stands today.
The well's bottom has a crawlspace too small for an adult. You need to come back as a child.
If you don't have it yet, learn the Song of Storms from the man in the windmill as an adult.
Warp to the Temple of Time and put the Master Sword back to become a child.
Inside the windmill, play the Song of Storms to the man at the organ. The blades speed up and the well drains.
Climb down the well and follow the narrow corridors past the Skulltulas to a plain wall with a plaque.
Walk straight into the wall. It is only an illusion.
steps.tip: In this dungeon, both walls and floors can be fake. Watch your step.

steps.text: Four corridors form a square around a closed central room. A Green Bubble circles them counterclockwise.
Its green flames go out each time it turns a corner. Chase it and hit it from behind then, until it dies.
Hidden pits in the corridors and the central room drop you into the basement. The map is down there, so a fall is not wasted.
Play the Sun's Song to freeze the two ReDeads, then defeat them so they don't bother you on later falls.
The way out needs five Silver Rupees. Two are on narrow planks over green ooze that hurts you; step carefully.
The third is in a pool to the north-west. The fourth lies on a dry path in front of boulders to the north.
Pots by each pool hold Bombs. Bomb the boulders in the south-east corner, past the green pit, to reach the last Silver Rupee.
Defeat the ReDead nearby and open the chest it guards for the map.
Go through the gate that opened to the south and climb the ladder to a room on the west side. It leads back to the main corridors.
On the north side, play Zelda's Lullaby at the Triforce symbol in front of the biggest fountain. The water drops and a new passage opens to the north.
Crawl through the tunnel and defeat the Skulltula. Head for the small chest at the end of the room and you fall into Dead Hand's lair.
Hands grab you from the ground. When Dead Hand lowers its head to bite, break free and hit its face; nothing else hurts it. Then jump aside.
After a few hits it burrows and more hands appear. Being held drains your life, but cutting every hand also draws it out. Bombs and Din's Fire hit several at once.
Each time it comes back, wait for the head to drop and attack it until Dead Hand falls.
Take the Lenses of Truth. They show fake walls, hidden pits and invisible enemies and chests, but drain magic while in use.
Look at the south edge of the pit with the Lenses to find a ladder. The corridor above has hidden alcoves with pots and ends on a ledge over the entrance corridor.
steps.tip: On the mesh platform there, the Lenses reveal a small chest with a Purple Rupee.

steps.text: Go back to the small chest above Dead Hand's pit. With the Lenses you can see the way around the hole; it holds a Business Scrub Seed.
Back in the square corridors, use the Lenses to find a new opening into the central room. Keep them on: pits are everywhere in there.
A gap keeps you from the big chest. The Lenses reveal a hidden opening on its west side: go round to the west corridor and jump in from the mesh platforms for the compass.
In the north-east corner, use the Lenses near the plaque to avoid the pits by the east door. Inside, deal with the Fire Keese and the Beamos and watch for more pits.
In the bright room to the south, stun the Like Like with the Boomerang, strike and back off. Repeat until it dies.
Look up between the two torches on the wall and take the Gold Skulltula with the Boomerang.
Take the ladder back down to the east corridor. Go to the south-east corner, look toward the central room with the Lenses and jump through the opening. The chest holds a Small Key.
Open the locked door in the north-east corner of the central room. Follow the path the Lenses show around the edge of the pit to a Gold Skulltula.
From the central room, jump across the drained corridor through the hole on the west side. Dive under the gate in the flooded pit and climb the mesh wall beyond.
Burn the webs on the coffins with a Deku Stick or Din's Fire. Watch out for Keese and Gibdos inside; Din's Fire hurts Gibdos badly.
The lone coffin on the east side holds the second Small Key.
Open the locked door in the north-west corner of the central room. Defeat the Deku Baba and take the Gold Skulltula in the corner.
When you're done, draw the Master Sword again and play the Nocturne of Shadow to warp to the graveyard.
Before you draw the sword, visit the Treasure Chest Shop in Castle Town at night. Wear the Lenses to see which chest holds the key each round and win a Piece of Heart.
A hidden ledge in the south-west corner of the well's corridors leads to a Business Scrub. Beat him and he sells Green Potions, handy for long Lens use.
As an adult, grab the vines on the Potion Shop's low roof and Longshot to the ladder high on the windmill. A chest at the top holds a Purple Rupee.

chapters.title: The Shadow Temple
chapters.summary: See through the temple's illusions with the Lenses of Truth, find the Hover Boots and defeat Bongo Bongo.

steps.text: Play the Nocturne of Shadow to warp to the ledge above the graveyard and go into the temple.
Put on the Lenses of Truth: a ring of invisible braziers fills the first room. Stand in the middle and cast Din's Fire to light them all and open the door.
Hold your shield up in the corridor so the Flying Pots smash on it. Longshot across the gap around the corner.
The wall with the face at the dead end is fake. Look at it with the Lenses and walk through.
With the Lenses on, only one skull column around the bird statue stays visible. Turn the statue so its beak points at it, to the north-west, and the east door opens.
The pit by that door is too wide to cross for now. You need lighter feet first.
Go through the hidden doorway behind the real skull column, on the north-west wall. In the room of skulls, the Lenses show another hidden door under a black skull to the north.
The room seals. Defeat the ReDead and the Keese; freeze the ReDead with the Sun's Song or circle behind it to slash its back. The big chest holds the map.
Go to the matching skull room west of the first one and find the hidden opening in its west wall.
Smash the Flying Pots. When a growing shadow and a red light warn of the Wallmaster, step back, then slash it before it rises.
Take the hidden exit in the north-west corner. The hallway floor drops away; climb the mesh wall on the far side.
Dead Hand is back. Let a hand grab you so it comes close, then break free and slash its face. Don't charge into the other hands.
Your adult sword hits much harder, so it falls quickly. Open the big chest for the Hover Boots.
steps.tip: Hover Boots let you float a moment after stepping off a ledge, but they are slippery. Take them off when you fight or walk normally.

steps.text: Run back through the hallway with the Hover Boots to float over the hole.
Back at the bird statue, make sure the beak points north-west. Run across the pit with the Hover Boots to the tongue platform.
In the next room, bomb the Beamos and the cracked wall. The Lenses show that the walls to the north and south are fake too.
Go south first. The door seals with two Gibdos; burn them with Din's Fire and keep your distance. The big chest holds the compass.
Go north to the room with spinning scythe statues and five Silver Rupees. Follow a scythe as it passes to take the first.
Run to the north-east and climb the thin wooden barrier for the second while the scythes pass below. Jump to the north alcove for the third.
steps.tip: Don't walk toward the plaque about the ferry in that alcove. A hidden hole drops you down to B4, where you can't go on yet.

steps.text: Dash to the other wooden barrier and Longshot to the target above the high ledge with the fourth.
Time a drop into the west alcove for the last one. Cross carefully to the area that opens and take the Small Key.
Unlock the door in the Beamos room. Drops of drool show where Skulltulas wait above in the twisting corridor.
Drop down at the end, slip past the falling guillotines and take the lift down.
Time your jumps past the guillotines and head south to the first big platform. Let the Stalfos swing first, then strike, and don't back into the pit.
To the east, the Lenses show an invisible platform halfway across the gap. Use the Hover Boots to reach the door.
steps.tip: A Business Scrub in a small alcove to the north, just before the door, sells supplies such as magic.

steps.text: The Lenses reveal a huge invisible spinning scythe. Shoot the Fire Keese with arrows, then run through behind a blade.
Keep running past the Like Like on the far side, or it may swallow your Hylian Shield. Defeat every enemy to open the east door.
Inside are two chests, one invisible. Take the Gold Skulltula on the far wall.
Back in the cavern, go west over three platforms that rise and sink. Move to the next one only when yours is at the top.
Below are a Beamos, two circling spike traps and five Silver Rupees. Step off the third platform at its highest point to float into the first one.
Bomb the Beamos. Climb the scaffolding to the south and float across the gap for the second, then drop as a spike trap passes to catch the third.
The fourth is just past the sealed door. The fifth sits on an invisible platform at the north edge, by the rat statues and chains.
Go through the west door. Two spiked ceilings crash up and down here. The Lenses show a hidden hole right of them with a stone block.
Pull the block out until it drops into a recess. Push it under the spikes, bit by bit, until it sticks out between both traps.
Pull the block west, staying under it, until you are both past the second trap. Climb it to the ledge above.
Ride on top of a falling spike ceiling to reach the other side of the ledge. The small chest holds a Small Key.
From the ledge, look at the north-east corner. Use the two spike ceilings as rising platforms to reach the high ledge with a Gold Skulltula.
Go back to the Silver Rupee area and north to the rat statues. The Lenses show a wooden platform moving between them below; drop onto it and unlock the door.
Keep the Lenses on: invisible spikes cover the floor. Freeze the two ReDeads with the Sun's Song and defeat them.
Take the Silver Rupee in the middle. Hookshot the hidden targets above the ones in the south-west and north-east corners.
Hookshot to the invisible ledge in the north-west and jump off it for the last one. The west door opens.
Defeat the Fire Keese, plus the two hiding in the walls of the top floor, to reopen the door. Throw a Bomb into the black skull cauldron for a Small Key.
Back in the spike room, Hookshot to the north-west ledge and float with the Hover Boots to the north ledge. Unlock the door there.
Fans blow you back in this hall. Wear the Iron Boots and work your way around the spike traps.
At the third fan, across a big gap, run over with the Hover Boots between gusts, then switch to the Iron Boots right away.
Look back the way you came. A Gold Skulltula hangs just below the ledge.
Drop into the lower hall and cross it with the Iron Boots on, between pits and fans. Longshot the pots in the side alcoves for supplies.
The far door locks you in with two ReDeads. Freeze both with the Sun's Song and finish them with a charged spin attack.
steps.tip: The Lenses show a small chest in the corner with a Business Scrub Seed.

steps.text: Back in the hall, one fan seems to blow at nothing. The Lenses show a hidden path; ride its wind across the gap with the Hover Boots.
Freeze the two Gibdos between the moving spike traps with the Sun's Song and defeat them.
Ignore the chest that appears. Bomb the cracked east wall and use the Lenses to find an invisible chest with a Small Key.
Unlock the north door and go down to the lowest floor.

sections.title: The ship and the Boss Key

steps.text: The lift brings you to a dock with a skeletal ship. Pull out the stone block on the left to the wooden platforms and climb onto the dock.
steps.tip: The block also opens a shortcut back up to B2 if you missed something.

steps.text: Look west above the shortcut lift. Play the Scarecrow's Song at the high ledge and Longshot up to Pierre for a Gold Skulltula.
Board the ship and play Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce mark. The ship starts to sail.
Two Stalfos appear one after the other. Bait their big swings and strike back. When the ship hits the far wall and sinks, jump off.
Bomb the cracked base of the standing bird statue so it falls and makes a bridge. The south door leads to the boss, but you need one more key.
Go west and burn the webs on the door with Din's Fire or a Fire Arrow.
This room is a maze of invisible walls with Floormasters. Use the Lenses to see the paths, and Din's Fire or a spin attack for the small hands they split into.
The north door is locked, so go south. Keep the Lenses on, defeat the invisible Floormaster and open the chest for the last Small Key.
Take the west door first. Throw a Bomb into each of the three skull cauldrons; one holds Rupees and a Gold Skulltula.
Unlock the north door. Spiked walls close in; burn their cobwebs with Din's Fire.
Defeat the ReDeads in the two spaces behind them. The big chest holds the Boss Key.
Return to the dock and cross the bird statue bridge.
steps.tip: On the other fallen statue, play the Scarecrow's Song toward the high ledge above the west wall. A pot up there holds a fairy.

steps.text: Through the south door, the Lenses show invisible platforms across a pit. Float across them with the Hover Boots to the boss door.
Bongo Bongo beats the drum you stand on and bounces you up. Wear the Hover Boots to stay steady.
While its hands glow purple, nothing hurts them. When a hand slams down from above, run from its shadow, then hit it once it stops glowing.
With both hands knocked away, look at the body with the Lenses. When it charges at you, shoot the eye with the Bow to stun it.
Take the boots off, run in and slash while it is stunned. Put them back on when it gets its hands back.
Next it sweeps a hand across the platform; the hand stays open to arrows the whole way. When it claps both hands, strafe while you shoot.
If you get knocked into the poison below, get out fast and float back over the four small platforms.
In the last phase it also grabs low along the platform, or pulls a fist back and punches. Run sideways from the punch and shoot the fist after it passes the middle.
Stun the eye one last time and attack with everything you have.
Take the Heart Container.
Step into the blue light. Impa, the Sage of Shadow, says Zelda is safe in hiding and gives you the Shadow Medallion. The last temple lies in the desert.

chapters.title: Missing in the desert
chapters.summary: Free the four carpenters in Gerudo Fortress, cross the Haunted Wasteland and learn the Requiem of Spirit at the Desert Colossus.

steps.text: Ride west to Gerudo Valley. The bridge over the canyon is gone now.
Longshot the wooden panel above the broken bridge, or ride Epona over the narrow bridge and jump the gap.
Talk to the head carpenter by the tent. His four workers went to the fortress and the Gerudo locked them up.
Walk up the path to the fortress. If a guard sees you, you get thrown in a cell; here that helps.
In the cell, Longshot the mesh in the skylight and climb out onto the jail roof.
From the jail roof, drop down to the barred windows on the ground floor. Shiro waves you to the door next to them.
Talk to Shiro and a Gerudo Thief attacks. Sidestep her jumping slashes, then hit her while she recovers.
steps.tip: When she crouches and spreads her blades, back away fast. Her spinning attack knocks you out and sends you to jail.

steps.text: Beat her and she drops a Small Key. Open Shiro's cell.
Leave the cell block to the south. In the walled yard, check the grate on the floor: the next carpenter is below.
The stairs down are beside a guard who faces west. Hit her from behind with the Longshot to stun her, then slip past while the other guard looks away.
Go down to the basement cells and talk to Ichiro. Beat the Gerudo Thief again for the second key and free him.
From Ichiro's cell, head north up the long stairs to the rooftops. Go south past the guard, who never turns, and climb the ladder to the third floor.
Enter the open doorway and talk to Saburo. Defeat the Gerudo Thief a third time and use the key on his cell.
Go back to the third floor balcony and take the door on the right. On the high walkway, Longshot the far doorway to fly over the guards.
On the rooftop, drop to the ledge with a door on the north side. Before going in, climb the low roof to the south and follow it around to the top roof.
Above the doorway, play the Scarecrow's Song at the gust of straw and Longshot to Pierre. Open the big chest for a Heart Piece.
Back on the ledge by the door, look up at the opposite wall at night for a Gold Skulltula.
Go through the door and follow the corridor around the northeast corner. Wait for the patrolling guard to walk north, then sneak to the cells.
Talk to Jiro and beat the Gerudo Thief one last time. Free him with the fourth key.
steps.tip: If you get caught, there is a faster way from the jail roof: jump east to a ledge, then Longshot from chandelier beam to chandelier beam over the war room.

steps.text: On your way out, the Gerudo captain stops you. She hands you the Gerudo Membership Card and asks you to find Nabooru, who went to the Spirit Temple.
Go to the big gate in the northwest of the fortress. The guards open it now.
Stop at the edge of the quicksand river and Longshot the wooden panel between the two posts on the far side.
Follow the flags through the sandstorm. Walk slowly, find the next flag, then go straight to it.
The flags go west, then north up a dune, northeast over a few dunes, west along a slope and north between two poles.
Down the big dune you reach a stone building with a plaque. Stand at the plaque and use the Lens of Truth to see a Poe guide.
Run after the guide; it turns often. Dodge the Leevers that pop out of the sand instead of fighting them.
The guide leaves at the oasis entrance. Keep to the rocks where you can; the Leevers never stop coming.
Walk toward the stone arch in front of the temple. Sheik teaches you the Requiem of Spirit, which warps you here.
Look at the temple entrance. One way needs strength to move a big rock and the other is a crawlspace too small for you, so you have to go back in time.
Gerudo Valley at night: a Gold Skulltula sits on the carved wall behind the carpenters' tent.
Gerudo Valley at night: by the grey rocks near the tent, look up at the rock arch for another Gold Skulltula.
Horseback archery, southeast of the fortress: score 750 points riding Epona for a Heart Piece.
Score 1,400 points at the same range for the Biggest Quiver.
At night, ride to the north end of the archery range. A Gold Skulltula sits on the back of the tall target; Longshot it.
In the Haunted Wasteland, go down under the stone building. At night a Gold Skulltula appears on the far wall.
Desert Colossus: blow open the cracked wall between the palm trees on the north side. Pay the Great Fairy 300 Rupees for Nayru's Love.
Desert Colossus at night: a Gold Skulltula appears on the rocks in the far northwest, where the Guay fly.
Play the Song of Storms at the dry oasis in the south of the Colossus to make a Fairy Fountain.
Give the Poacher's Saw to the head carpenter in Gerudo Valley. He gives you the Broken Goron's Sword.
Show it to Biggoron on the Death Mountain summit. His eyes hurt, so he gives you a Prescription for King Zora.
King Zora trades it for the Eyeball Frog. You have 2 minutes 30 seconds to bring it to the Lake Hylia lab.
steps.tip: Dive into the water below King Zora's room and take the tunnel; it comes out in Lake Hylia.

steps.text: The scientist makes the World's Finest Eye Drops. Get them to Biggoron within 3 minutes 30 seconds.
steps.tip: Fast route: lake tunnel to Zora's Domain, the river shortcut to the Lost Woods, the tunnel to Goron City, then up through the crater to the summit.

steps.text: Biggoron starts forging and gives you a Claim Check.
Come back after a few days, or play the Sun's Song several times until he stops hammering. Show the Claim Check for Biggoron's Sword.

chapters.title: Gerudo Training Ground
chapters.summary: Collect the keys in the Gerudo Training Ground and open the doors to the Ice Arrows at its center.

steps.text: With the Gerudo Membership Card, take the road southeast from the fortress toward the archery range. Pay the gate attendant 30 Rupees to go in.
steps.tip: You pay every time you enter, but your progress inside is kept.

steps.text: The entrance hall has three lion doors. The middle one leads to the prize maze; the side doors start a loop of rooms around it.
steps.tip: Keys are tight. Only open the doors this guide tells you to.

steps.text: Take the right door. Two Dinolfos and a Beamos wait behind a wall of fire. Blow up the Beamos with a Bomb or Bombchu first, or bounce its laser back with the Mirror Shield.
Bait the Dinolfos into jumping attacks and counter, or stun them with Deku Nuts and spin attack. A chest with a Small Key drops.
Go north into the lava room wearing the Goron Tunic. Grab the first Silver Rupee beside you and the second between the middle and right ledges.
Play the Song of Time at the blue square panel to make blocks. Step on the switch to drop the flames, then hover over with the Hover Boots to the third Silver Rupee.
Hover north and climb the ledges for the fourth Silver Rupee. Hookshot to the high ledge for the fifth; the gate on the right opens.
In the next room, play the Song of Time to remove the blue blocks and open a deep pool. Switch to the Zora Tunic and Iron Boots.
Sink to the bottom and Hookshot the two Shell Blades in the corners.
Take the Silver Rupee in the center and two more using the Hookshot targets on the walls. For the last two, take the boots off to float up into the corners.
steps.tip: Toggle the Iron Boots to rise and sink into the high spots.

steps.text: With all five, a gate opens to a chest with the second Small Key.
Back in the lava room, take the door above the blue blocks. It leads to an upper part of the central chamber with three chests; one holds the third Small Key.
steps.tip: Leave the locked doors on the left of that area alone. They only open a shortcut to the entrance and cost two keys.

steps.text: Now take the door on the high ledge at the north end of the lava room. Shoot the Fire Keese and smash the Torch Slugs with the Megaton Hammer.
Hammer away all the segmented statues around the room. One on the right hid a switch that puts out the fire around the middle chest: the fourth Small Key.
Head back to the entrance hall. The barred far door here opens later from the other side.
Take the left door from the entrance. Two Stalfos attack one at a time; bait their jump attacks and fight on the stone platforms. They leave the fifth Small Key.
The next room is a slope with rolling boulders, hidden flame walls and five Silver Rupees. Grab the one in the back left corner after a boulder passes.
Walk up and run down to the one in the opposite corner, then Hookshot the ceiling target above the entry door for the third.
Longshot up to the high front ledge for the fourth, or run up the left slope. The last one sits by the exit behind a flame wall; use the ceiling target again.
Fight two Wolfos and two White Wolfos in the next room. Keep moving along the wall and hit their backs.
One door here is fake. Break it, then use the Lens of Truth to see a hole in the wall above and Hookshot into it.
With the Silver Gauntlets, you can also push the black rock into the hole, shoot the hidden eye switch above the door, and clear the Like Like room.
steps.tip: Most chests in that room are junk or traps. The Small Key is in a chest only the Lens of Truth shows.

steps.text: Through the hole is a round lava room; wear the Goron Tunic. Drop down and shoot the eye target above the lower door.
A slab of eye targets rises while your platform spins. Hit them all to drain the lava and get a chest with a Small Key.
Next to the unsealed door, play the Scarecrow's Song at the gust of straw and Hookshot to Pierre. The door leads above the central chamber to another Small Key.
Return to the entrance and go through the middle door. Count your keys: with 7, leave the right door shut; with 8, you can open it.
steps.tip: The right door only opens a shortcut back to the lava room.

steps.text: Open the left door. Climb the mesh wall into a fake ceiling to reach a hidden floor with one more Small Key.
With six keys left, open every door toward the middle. Each small room has a chest with a few Rupees or arrows.
Open the big chest in the center for the Ice Arrows.
steps.tip: Ice Arrows melt Freezards in one shot and freeze moving spike traps for a while.

chapters.title: Spirit Temple
chapters.summary: Clear the Spirit Temple as a child and then as an adult, rescue Nabooru and defeat Twinrova.

steps.text: Play the Prelude of Light, put the Master Sword back in the Temple of Time and become a child again.
Before heading out, buy the last Magic Bean in Zora's River for 100 Rupees and bottle a bug.
Play the Requiem of Spirit. Plant the Magic Bean in the soft soil left of the temple entrance.
Let a bug go on the same soil and defeat the Gold Skulltula that comes out.
Inside, Nabooru is stuck at the big stone. Agree to bring her the temple's treasure, the Silver Gauntlets, and crawl through the small gap on the west side.
Dodge the spike traps and Fire Keese. Throw a Bomb at the Armos with the spinning spike trap; two gates open.
In the room with the pit and mesh wall, light the two torches on your side with Din's Fire. A chest appears across the pit.
On the right part of the mesh wall, hit the Gold Skulltula with the Boomerang.
Take the other door and defeat the Stalfos. Wait for its lunging jump, dodge, then stab; stun it with Deku Nuts or the Boomerang.
Throw the Boomerang off to the left so it curves back into the yellow switch across the pit. The bridge lowers; cut down the Green Bubbles on it.
The Anubis copies your moves and blocks attacks. Hit the eye switch on the edge of the north platform with the Slingshot to light the far platform.
Jump onto the platform on your side; the Anubis mirrors you into the fire and burns. The door opens.
You are now across the first pit. Beat the Wallmaster and Fire Keese, climb the mesh walls for five Silver Rupees and open the chest for a Small Key.
Take the north crawlspace to the locked door. Shoot the Skullwalltulas with the Slingshot and climb the mesh wall to 2F.
Defeat the two Lizalfos. Hit the yellow switch on the wall for a chest with Bombchus.
Stand on the sun emblem facing the cracked wall and send a Bombchu up it. Sunlight hits the emblem and the door opens.
In the giant statue room, carry fire from the lit torch with a Deku Stick to the other torch. The big chest has the Dungeon Map.
Check the northeast corner at the base of the statue for a Gold Skulltula.
Go up to 3F. Climb the small mesh wall and push the statue off the ledge onto the floor switch to open the barred door.
Take out the Beamos with Bombs or Bombchus, using the walls as cover.
Collect five Silver Rupees on the ledges. For the high one in the middle, pull a stone block under it and jump up from it.
Drag the block with the sun emblem into the beam of light on the west side. A chest with a Small Key appears in the alcove.
In the corridor past the gate, turn around and look above the doorway for a Gold Skulltula. Then open the locked door.
An Iron Knuckle wakes up. Its axe can't be blocked: back off from its two side swings and sidestep the overhead slam, then hit it while it recovers.
steps.tip: Lure it into the pillars to break them for hearts. Bombs and Bombchus hurt it well.

steps.text: Go out onto the colossus statue's hand and open the big chest for the Silver Gauntlets.
Kotake and Koume carry Nabooru off. Warp to the Temple of Time and take the Master Sword to become an adult.
Warp back with the Requiem of Spirit. Push the big black slab in the entrance hall with the Silver Gauntlets to open the east wing.
Bomb the switch above the Beamos to open both side doors. Take the northwest door and defeat the Wolfos.
Play Zelda's Lullaby at the Royal Family mark. A chest appears across the sand pit; Longshot to it for the Compass.
Take the northeast door to the boulder room. Walk off the middle ledge with the Hover Boots to grab the first Silver Rupee.
Get four more from the alcoves at the ends of the boulder lanes. In the far northwest alcove there is a Gold Skulltula.
Play the Song of Time to move the blue block and take the last Silver Rupee.
Stun the Like Like behind the gate with the Hookshot and destroy it. The chest holds a Small Key.
Unlock the north door in the east wing hub. Let the Flying Pots smash first, then defeat the Like Like and climb to 2F.
Put on the Lens of Truth to see the Floormaster and kill it. Spin attack the small hands it splits into.
Turn the mirror in the middle to aim the light at the sun emblems. The one to the south opens the door.
steps.tip: The chest one emblem drops is fake and freezes you. Another emblem calls a Wallmaster.

steps.text: In the statue room, Longshot to the statue's east hand, then to the northeast ledge. Pound the big switch with the Megaton Hammer.
Drop back to the hand and play Zelda's Lullaby at the Royal Family mark. A chest with a Small Key appears on the other hand.
From the west hand, play the Scarecrow's Song at the gust of straw high up and Longshot to Pierre for a Gold Skulltula.
Hookshot the target under the balcony on the east side to reach 3F and unlock the door.
steps.tip: The middle door at the base of the statue is a shortcut to the entrance once you push the black slabs.

steps.text: In the Anubis room, throw a Bomb onto the Beamos across the pit. Stand on the plate on the east side to light the fire pit.
Lure each Anubis into the fire: stand on the small ledge in the northwest corner, then jump to the southwest corner and walk west.
For the last one, play the Song of Time by the blue block mark to make a block in the south, then jump onto it. The east door opens.
In the corridor, lure the Armos into lunging at you so it falls into the recess onto the switch. The south door opens.
Defeat the second Iron Knuckle. Dodge its swings, then hit hard; break the pillars for hearts if you need them.
Go out onto the statue's other hand and step on the plate. The big chest holds the Mirror Shield.
Back in the corridor, reflect the sunbeam with the shield onto the sun emblem above the sealed door. Inside is a Small Key.
Unlock the west door in the Anubis room. Hold up the Mirror Shield and steer one Beamos' laser into the other, then back at the first.
Longshot over the moving spiked mesh walls instead of climbing them. Defeat the two Lizalfos halfway up.
On 4F, play Zelda's Lullaby at the Royal Family mark to open the door.
The doors around the burning chest are fake. Hammer the Torch Slugs and every door; one on the north side hides an eye switch.
Shoot the eye switch to lower the mesh gate. Longshot up, cross the walkway and step on the plate to put out the fire. Open the chest for the Boss Key.
Go up to the area west with a mirror on the ceiling. Drop down and hit the big switch to the south to open the west door.
In the rooms with the light beam, knock out the White Bubbles, then bomb the cracked wall on the east side.
Defeat the two Dinolfos in the last room. Turn that mirror to send the light north into the room with the tilted ceiling mirror.
Back in that room, drop down and shine your shield on the small sun emblem. The lit platform lowers you to the statue's face.
Reflect light onto the statue's face. It crumbles and opens the way to the boss.
An Iron Knuckle in black armor blocks the way. You only need to break its armor; dodge to its side and hit it, or roll Bombchus at it.
The armor falls off and it's Nabooru. Kotake and Koume take her again; follow them through the door.
Equip the Master Sword so you can always shield. The sisters' shields block everything except the other sister's magic.
When one sister draws a sigil and fires, stand in the middle and catch the beam on the Mirror Shield. Aim it at the other sister.
Hit them three times. Watch for fake outs where the sigil vanishes and the other sister attacks.
They merge into Twinrova. Catch three blasts of the same element with the shield and dodge the other element.
steps.tip: Blocking the wrong element undoes your charge. Each blast leaves a patch on the floor until the next one.

steps.text: The shield fires the stored energy back and she drops onto a small platform. Cross with the Hover Boots and slash her.
Put the sword away and shield again when she flies up. If she divebombs, jump off the platform and climb back up. Repeat until she falls.
Take the Heart Container.
Step into the light. Nabooru gives you the Spirit Medallion; all the sages are awake.
Desert Colossus as an adult: ride the bean plant. Jump off at the second small plateau and wait for night for a Gold Skulltula.
Ride the bean plant all the way around; it stops on the arch in front of the temple. Grab the Heart Piece.
Zora's Fountain: move the black rocks by the Great Fairy's fountain with the Silver Gauntlets. The cave has invisible Skulltulas; at the top, a Gold Skulltula appears at night.
With all 100 tokens, visit the House of Skulltula in Kakariko. The cured man gives you a Gold Rupee every time you talk to him.
With the Silver Gauntlets, the Gerudo Training Ground's last key room is open, if you haven't cleared it yet.

chapters.title: The castle of the King of Evil
chapters.summary: Get the Light Arrows from Zelda, clear the six barriers in Ganon's Castle, climb the tower and defeat Ganondorf and Ganon.

steps.text: Once all six Sages are awake, go back to the Temple of Time. Princess Zelda is waiting and gives you the Light Arrows.
Ganondorf seals Zelda in a crystal and takes her to his castle, which floats where Hyrule Castle used to be.
Walk to the edge of the ruins outside the castle. The Sages build a rainbow bridge to the entrance.
steps.tip: The huge rock pillar past the bridge needs a later upgrade. You get it inside the castle.

steps.text: Two Beamos guard the entrance hall. Turn their lasers on each other with the Mirror Shield and go through the door.
A barrier seals the central tower. Six doors, one per temple, feed it. Clear the barrier behind each door to open the way.
Look under the central bridge with the Lens of Truth. A hidden opening leads to a Fairy Fountain where you can refill your hearts.
Take the orange Spirit door on the left of the central bridge. Grab five Silver Rupees while spike traps slide around the room. Push statues aside to give yourself more room.
Reflect the center Beamos' laser back at it. Longshot the target overhead for the first Silver Rupee; the second is where the Beamos stood.
The other three are in the corners behind spike traps. The far back left one hides an Armos, so smash it with the Megaton Hammer first.
steps.tip: Ice Arrows freeze the spike traps so you can walk over them safely.

steps.text: In the next room, smash the two Torch Slugs with the Megaton Hammer. A chest with a Business Scrub Seed appears.
The door switch is behind a mesh wall with a small hole. Line up and send a Bombchu through the gap to hit it.
In the sun emblem room, shoot a Fire Arrow at the webs and boards on the ceiling. The real emblem is just right of the door you came in by; light it with the Mirror Shield.
steps.tip: If an emblem turns red as you light it, stop. A Floormaster or Wallmaster comes out.

steps.text: Shoot a Light Arrow at the barrier past this room. Nabooru sends you back to the main hall.
Take the green Forest door on the right of the central bridge, then go around the hall to the right for the rest. Beat the Wolfos that appears; a chest with arrows drops.
Light the torches near you with Din's Fire. Shoot a Fire Arrow at the last torch above the sealed door, or send a normal arrow through a lit torch.
The next room has floating platforms over a pit, fans in the corners and five Silver Rupees. Play the Song of Time at the blue square on the left wall to make a block in front of a fan.
Stand on the block and put on the Hover Boots. When the wind blows, run forward and let it carry you to the far platform.
Reflect the Beamos' laser, then hover to the opposite side for the next three Silver Rupees, one in front of another fan.
Step on the button on the low platform in the top left corner. A Hookshot platform rises to the last Silver Rupee.
Shoot a Light Arrow at the barrier. Saria sends you back to the main hall.
Take the next door to the right, the blue Water door. Melt the two Freezards by the Blue Fire with Fire Arrows.
The chest on the right holds Bombchus. The chest on the left keeps opening and closing; it is an ice trap, so leave it.
Empty a bottle, melt the red ice at the back with Blue Fire, then fill the bottle with Blue Fire again.
steps.tip: Release a fairy into the room so you can catch a new one at the Fairy Fountain later.

steps.text: Push the far ice block right into the barrier, then back into the small hole to fill the gap.
Push the near ice block right over the filled gap, then forward, then left until it stops under the far ledge.
Climb up, melt the red ice and hit the switch with the Megaton Hammer to open the door.
Shoot a Light Arrow at the barrier. Ruto sends you back to the main hall. Refill your bottle at the Fairy Fountain.
Rock slabs block the last two doors, so take the purple Shadow door next. The room is a huge pit with a few small platforms.
Light the torch on the tall pillar. Shoot an arrow through the burning torch by the door, or Longshot to the left platform and fire a Fire Arrow.
Platforms rise while the torch burns, so move fast. Shoot down the Green Bubbles and keep to the left as you cross.
Stun the Like Like with the Longshot and finish it with a charged spin attack. Cross the small gap with the Hover Boots.
Look right with the Lens of Truth for hidden platforms to a switch. It opens a big chest with the Golden Gauntlets.
Lift the rock slab and hit the switch behind it to unlock the door. Run across the hidden platform with the Hover Boots.
Shoot a Light Arrow at the barrier. Impa sends you back to the main hall.
Put on the Goron Tunic. Lift the slab in front of the red Fire door, next to the Shadow door, and go in. Five Silver Rupees sit around a lava hall.
The long middle path sinks under you. Run right to the low platform for the first Silver Rupee and jump back before it sinks too.
Take the first left to a round platform with a spinning fire trap. Time your jump past it for the second Silver Rupee.
Back on the middle path, keep left and lift the big stone slab for the third. A stalactite falls into the lava and makes a new platform.
Run to the far side past the Fire Bubbles for the last two. The fifth is on top of the new platform.
Longshot over to the barrier and shoot it with a Light Arrow. Darunia sends you back to the main hall.
Lift the last slab and go through the yellow Light door. Put on the Lens of Truth: an invisible Skulltula drops from the ceiling and invisible Keese hide in the walls.
Shoot the Keese before they fly out. Break the chests that open and close; they are fakes. The real chests hold Rupees.
In the next room, Zelda's Lullaby on the Royal Family crest only shows a chest with a Green Rupee. Use the Lens of Truth to find a chest in the opposite corner with the Small Key.
Two boulders roll around a three-way wall, with five Silver Rupees. Let a boulder pass, then run left to an alcove for the first and across to the inner alcove for the second.
Do the same on the other side for the third and fourth. Longshot the target in the middle of the ceiling to land on top of the wall for the fifth.
Dodge the Wallmaster that drops in. The Lens of Truth shows that the barrier sits behind a fake wall.
Shoot a Light Arrow at it. Rauru sends you back, and the seal on the central tower is gone.
Enter the tower, break the pots and ride the lift up. Shoot the Fire Keese on the first stairs with the bow.
Two Dinolfos wait in the next room. Sidestep their leaping strikes and answer with jump attacks or spin attacks.
Up the next stairs, two Stalfos attack. Stun them with Deku Nuts and hit hard while their guard is down.
Two Iron Knuckles sit on thrones until you bump into one. Lure them out one at a time and sidestep their swings, or blast them with Bombs and Bombchus from a distance.
With every enemy gone, the Boss Key appears.
Climb the stairs and pass the empty room with four pillars and lots of pots. Remember those pots. The boss door is above.
You cannot target Ganondorf in this fight. His magic shield stops every attack, Light Arrows included, so just face him.
When he slams the floor, parts of it fall to the pillar room below. Drop down to break the pots there for hearts and magic.
Hit his energy ball back with the Master Sword and keep the rally going. When he glows with power, the next ball is faster: answer it with a spin attack to stun him.
Shoot the stunned Ganondorf with a Light Arrow. He drops; jump over and slash him, then get back before he rises.
From the second round he sends fast balls early in the rally. After the third hit he also throws a big orb that splits into many; release a spin attack as they arrive to send them all back.
steps.tip: You can also back away with your shield up to block the split orbs.

steps.text: Near the end most of the floor is gone. After each Light Arrow, Longshot the mesh ledges to reach him. Stand at the sides of the platforms to avoid his shockwaves.
Zelda is free and the castle starts to fall apart. Follow her down the outer stairs. There is no time limit, but keep moving.
She opens the sealed doors as you go; break the pots while you wait. Jump across the crumbling platforms after her.
A gate traps you with two Stalfos. Cast Nayru's Love and use charged spin attacks without fear of their hits.
When the platform breaks, Longshot the target on the far archway. Link takes Zelda across with him.
The floor drops you to a lower room. While Zelda holds the monsters back, smash the cracked walls with the Megaton Hammer; the way out is left of the big fire pit.
ReDeads fill the bridge to the exit. Zelda freezes them; take them out with a charged spin attack and run for the exit.
In the ruins, a noise comes from the remains of Ganondorf's organ. Go and look.
Ganon knocks the Master Sword away and a ring of fire traps you. His weak spot is the glowing tail.
Stay out of reach of his wide sword sweeps. Wait for him to raise his blades with one glowing red: sidestep the tremor it sends straight ahead, then hit his tail while the blade is stuck.
Biggoron's Sword cuts the tail fastest. The Megaton Hammer works well too, and arrows, Bombs or Bombchus help in a pinch.
If you hit from behind, he leaps to turn around; back off before he lands. Run sideways from his quick forward stab to reach his back.
A Light Arrow to his face freezes him long enough to run behind him. The debris he breaks drops hearts and items.
steps.tip: Hide behind the debris when you need a breather.

steps.text: With the tail gone, Zelda throws you the Master Sword. Now aim for the glowing spots on his arms.
Before his overhead slam, magic pools on the ground and explodes. Wait it out to the side, then jump slash his arms and back away fast.
His sweeps now call down lightning along the blade's edge. Keep your distance until the blasts stop. Light Arrows at his arms work when they hold still.
With both arms done, he goes wild and lightning strikes the arena. You cannot stop him now. When he drops onto all fours, sprint sideways out of his charge.
Keep running along the edges until Zelda's spell opens the eye on his forehead. Wait for a gap between his slams and shoot a Light Arrow into the eye.
He falls to his knees. Hit him with everything and finish with the final strike to his eye. The Sages seal him away and the credits roll.
Once you have the Golden Gauntlets, cross the rainbow bridge and throw the huge rock pillar aside. The Great Fairy behind it wants 500 Rupees for halved damage.
steps.tip: Short on Rupees? With all 100 Gold Skulltulas, the House of Skulltula gives you Rupees whenever you visit.

steps.text: After the credits, load the save from before Ganondorf. The map now shows the total Heart Pieces and Gold Skulltulas in each area.
The Hall of Fallen Foes adds Ganondorf and Ganon, plus a final gauntlet against the toughest enemies in the game.

chapters.title: Malon's Friend
chapters.summary: Learn Epona's Song from Malon as a child, then win Epona from Ingo as an adult.

steps.text: Go to Lon Lon Ranch after your visit to Zelda at Hyrule Castle. There is little to do there before that.
Walk past the buildings to the horse field during the day. Malon stands in the middle, singing to a shy foal named Epona.
Talk to Malon and take out your ocarina when she asks. Play her tune back to learn Epona's Song; the foal runs right over.
steps.tip: Epona is too small to ride for now. Come back once you are an adult.

steps.text: Seven years later, Ingo runs the ranch for Ganondorf. Come back during the day and pay him 20 Rupees to ride in the pen.
steps.tip: Hookshot to the vines on the old tower in the ranch corner and climb up for a small chest.

steps.text: Play Epona's Song inside the pen and she gallops over. Ride a few laps to learn how she turns, speeds up with carrots and jumps fences.
Ride up to Ingo and talk to him. He races you once around the track for 20 Rupees. Hug the inside lane and spread your carrots over the straights.
Ingo demands a rematch with Epona as the prize. He is faster now: push on the straights so you take the corners ahead, then burn your last carrots near the finish.
Ingo shuts the gate behind you. Build up speed and jump Epona over one of the low fences along the ranch walls.
steps.tip: From now on, play Epona's Song in Hyrule Field or Lake Hylia to call her.

steps.text: Wake Talon in the big house in the middle of Kakariko with the Pocket Cucco. He promises to sort things out with Ingo.
Go back to the ranch. Talon is in charge again and Malon thanks you for freeing Epona.
Take Malon's obstacle course on Epona. Finish in under 40 seconds and she sends a reward to your house in Kokiri Forest.

chapters.title: A Song of the Royal Family
chapters.summary: Beat the two Composer Brothers in the Graveyard and learn the Sun's Song inside the Royal Family's Tomb.

steps.text: Enter the Graveyard behind Kakariko Village and walk to the back. A big stone with the royal crest sits between two harp-shaped graves.
Check each harp grave to call out Sharp the Elder and Flat the Younger. Like Poes, they vanish when targeted: back off until they show up, then rush in and strike.
With both brothers beaten, stand on the royal crest and play Zelda's Lullaby. The tomb entrance opens.
The first room locks you in with Keese hiding in the walls. Shoot them with the Slingshot, or block with your shield and slash as they fly off.
The next room has green goop that hurts and ReDeads whose scream freezes you. Creep along the left of the first pit, then slip down the middle between them to the far door.
Read the plaque at the end of the last room and play the melody under it to learn the Sun's Song.
steps.tip: The Sun's Song switches between day and night.

steps.text: Have Navi check the blue Fairy Writing on the broken pillars. It asks for the Sun's Song; play it to release a fairy that heals you.
Go back to the ReDead room and play the Sun's Song near them. Wait until they are frozen, then attack.

chapters.title: Happy Mask Shopkeeper
chapters.summary: Borrow four masks from the Happy Mask Shop, sell each to the person who wants it and pay the shop back.

steps.text: Show Zelda's Letter to the guard at Kakariko's gate to Death Mountain. He mentions the mask shop and wants a Keaton Mask.
Go to the Happy Mask Shop in Castle Town, talk to the shopkeeper until he is done, then borrow the Keaton Mask.
Sell it to the Kakariko guard for 15 Rupees, then pay the shop its 10 Rupees.
Borrow the Skull Mask. In the Lost Woods, take the first left from the entrance and sell it to the Skull Kid for 10 Rupees.
Pay the shop 20 Rupees for the Skull Mask. This one costs you 10 Rupees.
Borrow the Spooky Mask. Visit the Graveyard during the day and sell it to the boy copying Dampé for 50 Rupees.
Pay the shop 30 Rupees for the Spooky Mask.

sections.title: Bunny Hood and the shop's reward

steps.text: Borrow the Bunny Hood and wear it in Hyrule Field. Look for the Running Man; high ground helps you spot him.
steps.tip: At night he sits by the boulder northwest of Kokiri Forest.

steps.text: He stops when he sees the hood. Sell it to him for a Gold Rupee, worth 200 Rupees. Make room in your wallet first.
Pay the shop the 50 Rupees for the Bunny Hood. From now on you can borrow the Mask of Truth and the Goron, Zora and Gerudo Masks.
Wear the Mask of Truth to read people's thoughts and to talk to Gossip Stones. The race masks change what people say to you.

chapters.title: To the Great Fairy
chapters.summary: Find all six Great Fairy Fountains and pay each fairy for her spell or gift.

sections.title: Fountains you can reach as a child

steps.text: Every fountain works the same way: stand on the Triforce symbol by the water, play Zelda's Lullaby and pay the fee she asks for.
Death Mountain summit: past Goron City, bomb the cracked wall left of Kaepora Gaebora. Pay 25 Rupees for Din's Fire and your magic meter.
Hyrule Castle: bomb the cracked rock wall you passed on the way to Zelda. Pay 50 Rupees for the Gift of Improved Spin, which adds a magic wave to your spin attack.
Zora's Fountain: once King Zora has Ruto's Letter, go to the south side of the fountain and enter the large cave. Pay 100 Rupees for Farore's Wind.
steps.tip: Farore's Wind sets a warp point inside a dungeon.

steps.text: Death Mountain Crater: south of the shortcut from Goron City, smash the shiny rocks blocking a cave with the Megaton Hammer. Pay 200 Rupees for the Gift of Doubled Magic.
steps.tip: Wear the Goron Tunic to avoid heat damage.

steps.text: Desert Colossus: when you reach the Spirit Temple area, blow up the cracked wall on the right of the desert. Nayru's Love costs 300 Rupees.
Ganon's Castle: get the Golden Gauntlets in the Trial of Shadow. Light the far torch with a Fire Arrow, then use the Lens of Truth on the invisible path to the switch.
Go back outside and throw the black and gold pillar to the right of the castle entrance. Pay 500 Rupees for the Gift of Halved Damage.

chapters.title: Stir the Scarecrow's Soul!
chapters.summary: Make up a tune for the scarecrow at Lake Hylia as a child and play it back to him as an adult.

steps.text: At Lake Hylia, find the two scarecrows in the field between the Lakeside Laboratory and the fishing pond.
Talk to Bonooru, the one closest to the water with the green bandana, and play him a tune of your own on the ocarina.
steps.tip: Use five to eight notes and avoid any real song. He remembers pauses too.

steps.text: Write the tune down or pick something easy. It does not go into your song list yet, and you need it again in seven years.

sections.title: Play it back as an adult

steps.text: Come back to Lake Hylia as an adult. Only Bonooru is left; play him the same tune.
The tune becomes the Scarecrow's Song and Pierre, the scarecrow with the red bandana, shows up.
Watch for spots where straw swirls in the air. Play the song there and Pierre appears as a Hookshot target. Try the first one on the fishing pond dock.
steps.tip: Most of these spots lead to optional Rupees, Gold Skulltulas, Pieces of Heart or shortcuts.

chapters.title: From a Pocket Egg Comes…
chapters.summary: Trade your way from the Cucco Lady's Pocket Egg to Biggoron's Sword, racing three timers on the way.

steps.text: Get Epona first, and plan to free King Zora from the red ice with Blue Fire. Both are needed later.
steps.tip: After the Water Temple it gets easier: you have the Longshot and the shortcut from Lake Hylia to Zora's Domain is open again.

steps.text: Talk to the Cucco Lady in Kakariko Village to get the Pocket Egg.
The egg hatches at dawn. Play the Sun's Song to skip ahead and get the Pocket Cucco.
Enter the red-roofed, two-story house straight ahead of the village entrance. Show the Pocket Cucco to Talon, asleep in the bed under the stairs.
Give the Pocket Cucco back to the Cucco Lady. She hands you Cojiro, a blue Cucco.
In the Lost Woods, take the first left from the entrance. Show Cojiro to the man sleeping against the tall stump and he gives you the Odd Mushroom.
You have 4 minutes to reach the old woman behind Kakariko's Potion Shop. Warp songs end the timer and fail the trade.
steps.tip: Take the Lost Woods shortcut to Goron City (right, left, forward) and run down Death Mountain, or ride Epona across Hyrule Field.

steps.text: Go into the Potion Shop near the Death Mountain gate and out the side door left of the counter. Give the mushroom to the old woman in the shop out back.
steps.tip: At night, take a Cucco from the pen and glide over the windmill's metal gate into the back yard.

steps.text: No timer now, so warp if you like. Back at the stump in the Lost Woods, give the Odd Potion to Fado for the Poacher's Saw.
Take the saw to the head carpenter outside the carpenters' tent in Gerudo Valley. He swaps it for the Broken Goron's Sword.
steps.tip: If the valley bridge is still broken, jump the gap on Epona with a running start.

steps.text: Climb to the Death Mountain summit, by the Great Fairy Fountain. Show the sword to Biggoron and he gives you a Prescription for King Zora.
In Zora's Domain, thaw King Zora with Blue Fire if you have not yet. Show him the Prescription for the Eyeball Frog.
steps.tip: Blue Fire is in the Ice Cavern, and the Kakariko Potion Shop sells it too.

steps.text: You have 2 minutes 30 seconds to reach the Lakeside Laboratory. Take the Lost Woods shortcut just outside Zora's Domain, then ride Epona to Lake Hylia.
steps.tip: After the Water Temple you can go from Zora's Domain straight down to Lake Hylia.

steps.text: Give the frog to the scientist in the lab. He makes the World's Finest Eye Drops.
Now you have 3 minutes 30 seconds to reach Biggoron. Ride Epona to Kakariko and climb Death Mountain; watch for falling fire and spiders near the top.
steps.tip: After the Water Temple, chain the shortcuts: Lake Hylia, Zora's Domain, Lost Woods, Goron City, Death Mountain.

steps.text: Give Biggoron the eye drops. He gives you a Claim Check.
The sword takes three days. Play the Sun's Song until three days pass; Biggoron tells you how long is left. Then hand him the Claim Check.
